TL;DR: 本文提出"客户上下文图"（Customer Context Graph），将客户与业务上下文统一建模，使智能体不仅能回答客户说了什么，还能追问原因、影响对象、后续行动及是否解决。基于9,432条公开Cursor反馈和30个真实问题，将Agentic RAG、深度研究智能体与图支撑智能体进行对比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织日益依赖前沿语言模型分析客户反馈，但答案质量不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于反馈如何被组织与调用。传统检索方式缺乏对客户与业务上下文的结构化关联，难以支持因果、责任归属和闭环追踪等深层分析需求。

Method: 定义客户上下文图，用类型化关系连接客户对象（反馈、对话、用户、账户）、运营对象（工单、支持人员、商机、竞品）和分析/行动对象（分类概念、证据、洞察、工作项、结果）。图中数据来自公开Cursor反馈。在相同9,432条记录和30个问题（产品、事件、对比、元数据）上对比Agentic RAG、深度研究智能体和图支撑智能体。在缺乏完整真值的情况下，采用比较性评分标准，从答案质量（覆盖与组织）、分析深度（具体性与分解）、证据质量（引用支持与可追溯性）三维度联合评分，等权加权，并对引用记录抽样核验其主张。

Result: 在对齐评分标准下，客户上下文图支撑智能体总体得分0.961，深度研究智能体为0.710，Agentic RAG为0.651。图支撑智能体在30个配对问题中有27个领先深度研究智能体（符号检验p < 10^(-5)，其中26个严格最优）。其最大优势体现在分析深度（0.967 对 0.642），表现为更具体、层次化展开的发现，并带有量化主题和可追溯证据。

Conclusion: 结构化的客户上下文图能显著提升智能体对客户反馈的分析质量，尤其在分析深度与证据可追溯性方面优势明显。该架构可推广至任意反馈来源，为组织利用语言模型挖掘客户洞察提供了可复用的组织与检索范式。

Abstract: Organizations increasingly use frontier language models to analyze customer feedback, but answer quality also depends on how that feedback is organized and made available. We define a \emph{customer context graph} as a unified model of customer and business context. Typed relationships connect customer objects (feedback, conversations, users, and accounts), operational objects (tickets, support agents, opportunities, and competitors), and analytical or action objects (taxonomy concepts, evidence, insights, work items, and outcomes). This lets an agent investigate not only what customers say, but why, who is affected, what action followed, who owns it, and whether it was resolved. For this experiment, the graph is populated from public Cursor feedback; the same architecture can support any type of feedback source. We compare Agentic RAG, a Deep Research Agent, and a Customer Context Graph-backed Agent on the same 9,432 public Cursor feedback records using 30 realistic product, incident, comparison, and metadata questions. Without exhaustive ground truth, we jointly score responses on answer quality (coverage and organization), analytical depth (specificity and decomposition), and evidence quality (citation support and traceability), using a comparative rubric calibrated on 28 of the 30 questions. We sample cited records against their claims and weight the three dimensions equally. Under this aligned rubric, the Customer Context Graph-backed Agent scores 0.961 overall, versus 0.710 for the Deep Research Agent and 0.651 for Agentic RAG, and leads the Deep Research Agent on 27 of 30 paired questions (sign-test p < 10^(-5); strictly best on 26 of 30). Its largest advantage is analytical depth (0.967 versus 0.642), reflecting more specific, hierarchically developed findings with quantified themes and traceable evidence...

</details>


### [230] [Noise, Denoise, Correct: MCMC Posterior Sampling with Diffusion Priors in Three Steps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09407)
*So Takao,Gregory David Bellchambers,Luke Ye,Sanmitra Ghosh,Michalis Michaelides*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffusion Waltz，一种利用 SDEdit 式噪声-去噪过程作为提议的 MCMC 方法，并通过 Metropolis-Hastings 校正实现精确后验采样；同时引入无梯度的集合卡尔曼更新将观测注入提议，在非可微 Navier-Stokes 初始条件恢复任务中优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型是求解逆问题的强大先验，但在非线性、非可微前向模型下的后验采样仍然困难。现有方法往往依赖梯度信息或需要先验密度评估，限制了其在复杂场景中的应用。

Method: 提出 Diffusion Waltz：采用 SDEdit 风格的加噪-去噪过程作为 MCMC 提议，并用 Metropolis-Hastings 进行校正，从而实现无需先验密度评估的精确后验采样。进一步以无梯度的集合卡尔曼更新将观测信息注入提议，同时保持采样的精确性。

Result: 在非可微的 Navier-Stokes 初始条件恢复任务上，Diffusion Waltz 在不同噪声水平和非线性程度下均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: Diffusion Waltz 为非线性、非可微逆问题提供了一种无需梯度且保持精确性的后验采样框架，并在具有挑战性的流体任务上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models are powerful priors for inverse problems, but posterior sampling under nonlinear, non-differentiable forward models remain hard. We introduce diffusion waltz, an MCMC method using SDEdit-style noising-denoising as a proposal, corrected via Metropolis-Hastings for exact posterior sampling without prior evaluation. We further propose injecting observations into the proposal while preserving exactness, using a gradient-free ensemble Kalman update. On a non-differentiable Navier-Stokes initial condition recovery task, diffusion waltz outperforms existing baselines across different noise and nonlinearity regimes.

</details>


### [231] [Stability and Diversity of Networked Self-Consuming Generative Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09409)
*Xiukun Wei,Yang Zhang,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将多个自消耗生成模型建模为有向加权图中的节点，分析网络化递归训练的动力学的收敛条件与不动点，并探讨真实数据获取、跨模型数据消耗及交互图结构对长期稳定性与多样性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI广泛部署使合成内容与真实数据难以区分，合成数据不可避免地进入未来模型的训练流程，形成自消耗训练循环。已有研究多局限于单一模型自消耗或两模型间的简化交互，缺乏对多个模型通过网络化路径相互消耗合成数据的分析。

Method: 提出理论框架，将模型表示为有向加权图的节点，边权重控制合成数据在模型间的流动；在该框架下分析重训练动力学下网络化模型的长期行为，建立收敛条件并刻画所得不动点。

Result: 建立了网络化自消耗模型的收敛条件，刻画了系统的不动点，并揭示了模型对真实数据的获取、跨模型数据消耗以及交互图结构如何影响系统的长期稳定性与多样性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次对网络化自消耗生成模型进行理论刻画，为理解多模型相互消耗合成数据时的长期稳定性与多样性提供了分析基础。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of generative AI has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish synthetic content from real data. Consequently, synthetic data is inevitably incorporated into the training pipelines of future model generations, forming a self-consuming training loop. Prior work has studied the effects of such recursive self-consuming training, but analyses have largely been limited to isolated models, where a model consumes only its own synthetic data, or to simplified interactions between two models. This paper takes a first step toward understanding networked self-consuming generative models, in which multiple models consume synthetic data generated by one another through complex interaction pathways. We introduce a theoretical framework representing models as nodes in a directed, weighted graph, with edge weights governing the flow of synthetic data among models. Using this framework, we analyze the long-term behavior of networked models under retraining dynamics, establishing conditions for convergence and characterizing the resulting fixed points. We further investigate how the system's long-term stability and diversity are shaped by each model's access to real data, cross-model data consumption, and the structure of the interaction graph.

</details>


### [232] [Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09411)
*Dominik Schnaus,Thomas Dagès,Daniel Cremers,Xi Wang,Phillip Isola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Wasserstein Procrustes方法，证明粗粒度跨模态对齐无需成对样本，仅通过正交映射估计即可对齐独立训练的嵌入空间，并在少样本和零样本场景下优于或媲美现有方法，还能支撑无配对文本到图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态表示虽支持零样本分类与检索，但独立训练的模型对齐通常依赖大量成对数据。受"柏拉图表示假说"启发——不同模态训练的模型可能自发收敛到共享的表示几何——作者质疑：跨模态对齐是否真的需要成对样本？

Method: 提出Wasserstein Procrustes方法：利用粗粒度几何初始化，在完全不看任何配对样本的情况下，通过估计一个正交映射来对齐两组互不相交的嵌入集合。

Result: 跨数据集、模态和单模态模型，该方法能稳定对齐独立训练表示；标准几何对齐指标可准确预测何时可行。在极少配对场景下显著优于现有方法，并在更多配对时保持竞争力；对齐结果还能实现无配对样本的文本到图像生成。

Conclusion: 独立训练的模型往往共享足够的几何结构，使得跨模态对应关系可在极少甚至零配对数据下建立，挑战了跨模态对齐必须依赖成对样本的传统认知。

Abstract: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.

</details>


### [233] [Self-Consuming Generative Models with Co-Evolving Human Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09415)
*Xiukun Wei,Tian Xie,Ding Zhu,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究生成模型自消费迭代训练中模型分布与用户偏好共同演化的耦合动态，发现完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据会放大初始偏差并趋向单一均衡，而注入足量参考数据可产生唯一全局吸引均衡，并提出联合选择参考分布与混合权重的算法以控制长期结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作大多假设用户偏好固定，但实际中用户对模型输出的接触会逐渐改变其偏好，形成模型分布与用户偏好协同演化的反馈回路。理解这种耦合动态的长期行为尚缺乏研究。

Method: 将用户筛选合成数据的迭代训练建模为耦合动态系统，分析其长期均衡行为；对比完全依赖合成数据与注入参考数据两种情况；进而提出一种高效算法，联合选择参考分布及其混合权重，以引导系统趋向理想均衡并最小化数据收集成本。

Result: 当训练完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据时，迭代筛选会放大初始偏差，系统趋向多个单一均衡之一，初始占优的实例最终主导；当以足够大的比例注入参考数据时，动态发生根本改变，产生唯一的全局吸引均衡。

Conclusion: 参考数据注入可用于控制耦合系统的长期结果，所提算法能够将系统引导至保留期望属性的均衡，同时降低数据收集成本。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly trained in self-consuming iterative loops, where users curate preferred samples from model-generated candidates and the curated samples are used to train future generations of the model. Prior work has largely assumed fixed user preferences, but in practice exposure to model outputs gradually reshapes what users perceive as desirable, creating a feedback loop in which model distributions and user preferences co-evolve. We take a first step toward understanding the long-term behavior of such coupled dynamics. We show that when training relies entirely on user-curated synthetic data, iterative curation amplifies initial biases and drives the system toward one of multiple singleton equilibria in which the instance holding an initial advantage eventually dominates. In contrast, injecting reference data into training at a sufficiently large rate fundamentally changes the dynamics and yields a unique globally attracting equilibrium. Building on this insight, we study how reference-data injection can be used to control long-term outcomes, and propose an efficient algorithm that jointly selects a reference distribution and its mixing weight to steer the coupled system toward equilibria that preserve desired attributes while minimizing data collection costs.

</details>


### [234] [What a Reporting Convention Hides: A Matched-Budget Audit of Quantum Natural Gradient with an Exactly Computed Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09425)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了Adam、SPSA和量子自然梯度（QNG）三种变分量子优化器，指出仅统计成功达到目标损失的运行会掩盖真实成本差距。作者以电路评估次数计价、统一预算，并惩罚所有未达标运行。结果显示：SPSA达到宽松目标所需评估次数是Adam的两倍多；QNG在严格目标上领先Adam，但当把与参数线性相关的模拟器代价换成与参数二次相关的硬件估计后，该领先消失。建议对每次未达标运行计满预算，并跨多个目标报告结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有变分量子优化器比较研究通常只计时达到目标损失的运行，或仅在某单一目标处读取结果。这两种惯例都可能影响对优化器"昂贵步骤是否值得"的判断，因此需要量化不同评估惯例对结论的影响。

Method: 在从设置选择中留出的初始化上，比较Adam、SPSA和QNG。计算预条件QNG所需的精确度量，以电路评估次数为每一步定价，并给所有方法相同预算；同时考察宽松与严格目标、是否剔除未达标（删失）运行，以及模拟器代价（参数线性）与假定硬件代价（参数二次）两种情形。

Result: 在跨电路宽度、代价族和设置扫描的中位数汇总中，SPSA达到宽松目标所需评估次数是Adam的两倍多；剔除未达标的删失运行会掩盖这一差距。在全球代价族固定为严格目标所选设置时，QNG通常晚于Adam达到宽松目标，但最先达到严格目标。当把与参数线性相关的模拟器代价替换为与参数二次相关的硬件估计后，QNG的严格目标领先优势消失。

Conclusion: 评估惯例会显著改变优化器优劣结论。建议对每次未达标运行计入完整预算，并在多个目标上报告判定结果，以避免因删失运行或单一目标而得出偏颇结论。

Abstract: Several published comparisons of variational quantum optimizers time only runs that reach a target loss, or read the verdict at a single target. Either convention could decide whether an optimizer's costlier steps pay off. We measure how much each convention changes verdicts among Adam, simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) and quantum natural gradient (QNG), on initializations held out from the selection of settings. We compute the exact metric that preconditions QNG, price every step in circuit evaluations and give every method the same budget. In a median pooled over circuit widths, cost families and a sweep of settings with common misses, SPSA needs more than twice Adam's evaluations to reach a loose target. Dropping the censored runs that miss the target hides this gap. On the global-cost family we hold fixed the settings selected for a strict target. QNG then usually reaches the loose target after Adam but the strict target first. QNG's strict-target lead disappears when the metric's simulator price, linear in the number of parameters, is replaced by an assumed hardware count quadratic in that number. We recommend charging every miss the budget and reporting verdicts across targets.

</details>


### [235] [An extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09433)
*Han Zhang,Mehrisadat Makki Alamdari,Babak Shahbodagh,Mohammad Vahab,Cosmin Anitescu,Timon Rabczuk,Elena Atroshchenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出扩展深度能量法求解热-力耦合裂纹扩展，裂纹保持尖锐折线，温度与位移双网络经标量嵌入函数感知裂纹，交错最小化能量泛函，应力强度因子精度高、裂纹路径与文献吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经能量求解器已用于相场断裂并可表示尖锐裂纹，但裂纹域上的瞬态热传导及热应力驱动的裂纹扩展尚未在这些求解器中同时处理，本文旨在填补该空白。

Method: 构建扩展深度能量法：用两个网络分别表示温度与位移，通过跨裂纹间断、其余光滑的标量嵌入函数输入裂纹，无需正则化长度；位移在裂尖由Williams展开并带可训练幅值富集；以交错序列最小化增量导热泛函与热弹性势能；采用分层于背景单元的Monte Carlo积分，裂尖附近加密并在训练中重采样；由Wilson-Yu面积项交互积分提取应力强度因子并用轮廓半径扫描校验；当裂尖温度下弯折能量释放率达到临界值时，裂纹沿最大环向应力角扩展。

Result: 静止热边裂纹的应力强度因子与文献值误差0.11%；功能梯度剪切试验的起裂与独立尖锐裂纹有限元解相差不超过一个载荷步；缺口十字形试样在机械、热及复合载荷下的裂纹路径与文献解一致。

Conclusion: 该扩展深度能量法能够在无正则化长度下统一处理尖锐裂纹的瞬态热传导与热-力耦合裂纹扩展，精度经文献值与有限元解验证，适用于复杂载荷下的裂纹路径预测。

Abstract: Thermo-mechanical fracture couples transient heat conduction on a cracked domain with a crack that grows as the temperature and the displacement evolve. Neural energy solvers have been proposed for phase-field fracture and later extended to represent a sharp crack through the network input, but heat conduction on the cracked domain and crack propagation under the resulting thermal stresses have not yet been treated together in these solvers. We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline. Two networks represent the temperature and the displacement and receive the crack through a scalar embedding function, discontinuous across the crack and smooth elsewhere, so that both fields can jump across it without a regularization length, and the displacement is enriched near the tip by the Williams expansion with trainable amplitudes. The two fields are obtained by minimizing an incremental conduction functional and the thermoelastic potential energy in a staggered sequence, with Monte Carlo integration on points stratified over background elements, densified near the tip and redrawn during training. The stress intensity factors are extracted by the interaction integral with the area term of Wilson and Yu and checked by a sweep of the contour radius, and the crack advances at the maximum hoop stress angle when the energy release rate of the kink reaches the critical value at the crack-tip temperature. On a stationary thermal edge crack the extracted stress intensity factor agrees with the published value to 0.11%, in a functionally graded shear test initiation agrees with an independent sharp-crack finite element solution to within one load step, and on a notched cruciform specimen the crack paths follow the published solutions under mechanical, thermal and combined loading.

</details>


### [236] [GeoPrior-Mamba: Structured Process Priors with Mamba for Fine-Resolution XCO2 Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09456)
*Zhao Meng,Yinan Cai,Siru Zhong,Juepeng Zheng,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GeoPrior-Mamba，用语言模型离线构建结构化过程先验，通过轻量适配器注入多方向 Mamba 骨干，实现稀疏卫星观测下的高精度 XCO2 场重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏卫星观测重建精细分辨率 XCO2 场时，空间结构受直接观测约束弱。现有学习方法把环境协变量当作普通数值输入，需在稀疏监督下自行学习异质的源汇关系，难度大且监督不足。

Method: GeoPrior-Mamba：多方向 Mamba 框架 + 离线语言模型诱导的结构化过程先验。语言模型不参与预测，而是在训练前将生物圈吸收、生态系统呼吸、人为排放的相对过程知识整理为确定性先验表；再用地理、生态、排放相关和季节信息将其空间实例化，并通过轻量知识适配器自适应注入重建骨干。使用 2018-2020 年 OCO-2 观测。

Result: 在留出观测上 RMSE 0.81 ppm、R2 0.93；相比 CAMS 背景插值 RMSE 降低 48.2%，相比 Trans-XCO2 在同评估协议下降低 3.1%。消融显示知识先验分支有可测贡献，且收敛明显快于无知识先验的 Mamba 骨干。独立 TCCON 评估支持重建场与地基柱 CO2 观测的一致性。

Conclusion: 当难以直接获得全球一致的过程-响应表示时，语言模型可作为构建结构化过程先验的实用机制，且保持置于数值预测回路之外。

Abstract: Reconstructing fine-resolution column-averaged dry-air CO2 (XCO2) fields from sparse satellite observations requires models to infer spatial structure that is only weakly constrained by direct measurements. Existing learning-based methods typically treat environmental covariates as ordinary numerical inputs and must therefore learn heterogeneous source-sink relationships largely from sparse supervision. We introduce GeoPrior-Mamba, a multi-directional Mamba framework augmented with offline language-model-induced structured process priors. Rather than using a language model to predict XCO2, we use it before training to organize relative process knowledge for biospheric uptake, ecosystem respiration, and anthropogenic emissions into deterministic prior tables. These priors are spatially instantiated using geographic, ecological, emission-related, and seasonal information and are adaptively injected into the reconstruction backbone through a lightweight knowledge adapter. Using OCO-2 observations from 2018-2020, GeoPrior-Mamba achieves an RMSE of 0.81 ppm and an R2 of 0.93 on held-out observations, reducing RMSE by 48.2% relative to CAMS background interpolation and by 3.1% relative to Trans-XCO2 under the same evaluation protocol. Ablation experiments show a measurable contribution from the knowledge-prior branch and substantially faster convergence than the knowledge-free Mamba backbone. Independent TCCON evaluation further supports the consistency of the reconstructed fields with ground-based column CO2 measurements. These results suggest that language models can provide a practical mechanism for constructing structured process priors when globally consistent process-response representations are difficult to obtain directly, while remaining outside the numerical prediction loop.

</details>


### [237] [DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09457)
*Yujia Zheng,David Klindt,Randall Balestriero,Bernhard Schölkopf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DSReg（依赖稀疏正则化），在无重建、无解码器、无标签条件下，证明可从JEPA类线性可辨识表征中恢复出各个世界潜在变量，并指出其条件"结构多样性"弱于此前所有可辨识潜变量模型的结构条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性ICA、字典学习与因果表征学习需依靠重建、辅助监督或非高斯性等分布不对称来锚定潜变量；而JEPA等无锚方法只能将潜状态辨识到线性变换，导致各潜变量仍相互混合。论文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出结构多样性（Structural Diversity）条件：不同潜变量在观测上留下不同的依赖足迹。基于LeJEPA的线性可辨识性，证明在该条件下DSReg（依赖稀疏正则化）可恢复各世界潜变量至带符号置换。该方法为事后处理，可作用于任意线性可辨识表征并复用已训练检查点。

Result: 结构多样性严格弱于已有可辨识潜变量模型的所有结构条件。在合成场景、世界模型探针、学习到的视觉编码器及外部渲染器上，DSReg在保持密集预测能力的同时，提升了各潜变量恢复效果及下游任务表现，并具有可扩展性。

Conclusion: 建立了首个完全可辨识的JEPA，无需重建或解码器即可恢复每个世界潜变量，且该方法可即插即用于任意线性可辨识表征，兼顾密集预测与个体潜变量恢复。

Abstract: Methods that recover individual latent variables of the world, from nonlinear ICA to dictionary learning and causal representation learning, anchor the latents to observations through reconstruction, auxiliary supervision, or distributional asymmetries such as non-Gaussianity. Methods without these anchors, including joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs), identify the latent state only up to a linear transformation, so individual latents remain mixed. We close this gap: individual world latents can be provably recovered with no reconstruction, no decoder, and no labels. The key condition is Structural Diversity: different latents leave distinct dependency footprints on observations, just as no two snowflakes are alike. Building on the linear identifiability that LeJEPA provides, we prove that under Structural Diversity, DSReg (Dependency-Sparsity Regularization) recovers individual world latents up to signed permutation, without reconstruction or a decoder. It applies post hoc to any linearly identified representation, reusing trained checkpoints at no loss over joint training, and establishes the first fully identifiable JEPA that recovers every world latent. Moreover, as a condition on dependency footprints, Structural Diversity is strictly weaker than all structural conditions of prior identifiable latent variable models. Across synthetic regimes, world model probes, learned visual encoders, and external renderers, DSReg preserves dense prediction while improving individual-latent recovery and downstream use with scales.

</details>


### [238] [When Should an In-Context Learner Expand Its Hypothesis Space?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09471)
*Weihan Li,Xinlei Chen,Junhao Wu,Tianshi Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"结构修正环境"（Structural Revision Environment），将模型族扩展决策建模为代价敏感的序贯决策问题，区分结构证据与扩展价值，并检验Transformer与语言模型是否能完成这一区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习系统在熟悉的模型族内适应很快，但更早、更难的步骤是：从可能是噪声、例外、族内变化或族外结构的观察中，判断是否值得付出代价开启更丰富的模型族。现有研究多关注证据阈值，而忽略了扩展的价格与剩余视野对决策的影响。

Method: 构建结构修正环境，使不同来源产生匹配的预测失败，并独立变化扩展价格与剩余视野；该环境支持精确贝叶斯计算与一次性决策的精确规范性解。随后训练Transformer，并测试三个后训练谱系的语言模型，以及允许推理的三个模型，另对元训练学习者进行受控后训练。

Result: 精确解显示修正是价值边界而非证据阈值：同一历史在不同价格、视野和宣告查询下最优动作不同；局部修复与扩展的边界由规则无法覆盖的输入决定；对更丰富族的信念远早于决策发生跨越。Transformer仅从效用中即可复现该边界。语言模型的预测带有失败敏感信号，但修正决策未反映该信号，且在给定扩展收益时未与价格和视野权衡。允许推理的模型按参考比例权衡给定收益，但仍未将历史转化为对扩展收益的估计。受控后训练可改变先验与预测锐度，但不改变决策标准。

Conclusion: 结构修正的核心是价值判断而非证据判断；当前语言模型能将失败信号编码进预测，却未能将其转化为基于价格与视野的扩展决策，这一能力缺口对学习系统的结构自适应具有关键意义。

Abstract: Learning systems adapt quickly inside a familiar family of models. The harder step comes earlier: deciding, from observations that could be noise, an exception, a change within the family or structure outside it, whether opening a richer family is worth its cost. We treat this as a costly sequential decision: prediction failure must be turned into structural evidence, evidence into a value of expansion, and value into action. The Structural Revision Environment produces matched failures from each source, varies the price of expansion and the remaining horizon independently of the evidence, and admits exact Bayesian calculations and an exact normative solution of the one-shot decision. Its solution shows that revision is a value boundary and not an evidence threshold: one history has different optimal actions under different prices, horizons and announced queries, the boundary between local repair and expansion is set by the inputs a rule predicts and a repair cannot cover, and belief in the richer family crosses long before the decision does. Transformers trained in the environment reproduce this boundary from utility alone. Language models of three post-training lineages carry a failure-sensitive signal in their predictions that is not reflected in their revision decisions, and given the gain of expanding they read it without weighing it against price and horizon. Three models allowed to reason weigh the stated gain in the reference's proportions and still do not turn the history into an estimate of what expansion would buy. Controlled post-training of the meta-trained learners moves the prior and the sharpness of predictions, and neither moves the criterion.

</details>


### [239] [MORA: Modeling Observed Changes for Drift-Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09473)
*Xudong Mou,Tiejun Wang,Rui Wang,Hui Wang,Pin Liu,Tianyu Wo,Xudong Liu,Renyu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MORA 框架，通过配对短期与长期视图重建同一局部目标，用重建差距衡量局部偏差的上下文支持度，从而在非平稳时间序列中区分真实异常与分布漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳环境下，分布漂移与真实异常会产生相似的局部变化，现有方法（适应检测到的漂移或学习漂移不敏感表示）无法消解这种歧义。作者将此问题定义为"时间变化消歧"。

Method: MORA 从配对短期和长期视角重建同一局部目标；重建差距度量局部偏差的上下文支持；数据依赖的校正机制保守地调整主局部异常分数，仅当上下文能更好重建同一目标时才降低分数。无需漂移标注和在线适应。

Result: 在四个 TSAD 基准上的实验表明，MORA 对非平稳性具有较强鲁棒性，同时保持对真实异常的敏感性。

Conclusion: MORA 有效解决了时间变化消歧问题，兼顾鲁棒性与敏感性，且不需要漂移标注或在线自适应。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) identifies deviations from patterns learned from historical data. In non-stationary settings, distribution drift and true anomalies can cause similar local changes, making it difficult to tell whether a deviation reflects abnormality or evolving context. Existing methods typically adapt to detected shifts or learn drift-insensitive representations, but do not resolve this ambiguity. We define this problem as \emph{temporal change disambiguation}: determining whether a local deviation is explained by broader temporal evolution. We introduce MORA, a drift-robust TSAD framework that reconstructs the same local target from paired short- and long-term views. The reconstruction gap measures contextual support for a local deviation, and a data-dependent correction mechanism conservatively adjusts the primary local anomaly score. Context can only reduce the score when it improves reconstruction of the same target. MORA needs neither drift annotations nor online adaptation. Experiments on four TSAD benchmarks show strong robustness to non-stationarity while preserving sensitivity to genuine anomalies.

</details>


### [240] [CHASE: Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation for Geometry-Aware Model Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09476)
*Wei Wang,Wei Jiang,Ziran Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于几何与谱对齐（GSA）结构的实用方法框架CHASE，涵盖六种跨模型修改、重配置与压缩的应用，验证了GSA结构可直接用于方法设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作通过谱集中、物理通道对齐、支撑结构与奇异基变化来刻画训练网络（GSA），但这些结构尚未被系统性地用于实际的模型设计。作者希望把这些可观测结构转化为可落地的模型操作方法。

Method: 提出CHASE框架，包含六种应用：CORA（参数高效微调）、COEC（结构化剪枝补偿）、CORAM（模型融合）以及三种新方法——CAGA（利用GSA识别可共享KV表示的多头注意力头，并通过几何对齐与低秩子空间提取构建共享K/V头）、SAKV（确定可共享低秩KV-cache表示的相邻层及各层组保留秩）、CAPS（依据谱结构对输出神经元分组，并为每组单独选择保留的输入通道）。

Result: CORA、COEC、CORAM验证了GSA在适配、剪枝补偿与模型融合上的有效性；CAGA显示几何共享头构建显著改善MHA到GQA的转换；SAKV与CAPS在KV-cache压缩和结构化剪枝上优于代表性基线。

Conclusion: GSA所识别的结构可直接用于设计多种模型操作方法，表明几何与谱对齐为模型重配置与压缩提供了实用且有效的设计工具。

Abstract: Geometric and Spectral Alignment (GSA) characterizes trained networks through spectral concentration, physical-channel alignment, support structure, and changes in singular bases. In this paper, we propose CHASE (Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation) to use these structures in practical model design. CHASE covers six applications across model modification, reconfiguration, and compression. CORA, COEC, and CORAM apply GSA to parameter-efficient finetuning, structured-pruning compensation, and model merging. We further develop three new methods. CAGA uses GSA to identify multi-head attention heads that can share a KV representation and constructs the shared key and value heads through geometric alignment and low-rank subspace extraction. SAKV uses GSA to determine which adjacent layers can share a low-rank KV-cache representation and the retained rank for each layer group. CAPS uses GSA spectral structure to group output neurons and selects retained input channels separately for each group. Results from CORA, COEC, and CORAM establish the effectiveness of GSA for adaptation, pruning compensation, and model merging. Experiments on CAGA show that geometric shared-head construction substantially improves MHA-to-GQA conversion, and SAKV and CAPS improve over representative baselines for KV-cache compression and structured pruning. These results show that the structures identified by GSA can be used directly to design methods for a range of model operations.

</details>


### [241] [Safe on Average, Unsafe in the Tail: When Is the Episodic-Cost Tail Controllable?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09508)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用CVaR_0.1度量情节成本的尾部风险，区分"均值安全但尾部不安全"的策略，并研究在保持回报的同时控制尾部违规的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全强化学习方法大多将约束施加于期望情节成本，标准评估也只报告平均情节成本，无法刻画成本在情节间的分布。因此，满足均值约束的策略在最差情节中可能仍不安全，而均值报告既无法识别这种尾部违规，也无法说明是否能在保持回报的前提下将其控制在预算内。

Method: 使用CVaR_0.1（最差10%情节的平均成本）度量情节成本尾部，将策略分类为"尾部安全"（CVaR_0.1在安全预算内）。首先在三个Safety-Gymnasium导航任务上评估五种标准算法以识别尾部不安全策略；随后在密集危险导航任务上考察四类约束族，并在四个导航与四个运动任务上评估尾部控制效果。

Result: 在Safety-Gymnasium导航任务中识别出均值安全但尾部不安全的策略；在密集危险导航任务上比较了四类约束族的尾部控制表现，并在四类导航与四类运动任务上验证了尾部可控性。

Conclusion: 仅报告平均情节成本会掩盖尾部风险，应以尾部指标（如CVaR_0.1）补充评估安全策略，并进一步研究在保证回报的同时约束尾部违规的可行性。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximize return while satisfying constraints on cumulative cost. Most methods impose these constraints on expected episodic cost. Consequently, standard evaluations report mean episodic cost without characterizing how cost is distributed across episodes. A policy that satisfies the mean-cost criterion may therefore remain unsafe in its worst episodes. Mean-cost reporting neither identifies this tail violation nor shows whether it can be brought within budget while preserving return. In this work, we measure the episodic-cost tail using $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$, the average cost of the worst $10\%$ of episodes. We classify a policy as tail-safe when $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$ is within the safety budget. This allows us first to identify policies that are safe on average but unsafe in the tail and then to study whether their tail violations can be controlled while preserving return. To identify tail-unsafe policies, we evaluate five standard algorithms on three Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks. We then examine four constraint families on dense-hazard navigation and assess tail control across four navigation and four locomotion tasks.

</details>


### [242] [Physics-Informed Neural Plasticity: PDE Solvers That Reshape Themselves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09510)
*Chun-Wun Cheng,Bingcheng Hu,Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"物理信息神经可塑性"范式与ReCAP方法，让PDE求解器的表示结构在训练中动态重塑，在5个3D/4D基准上取得最低相对L2误差（降低10.7%–27.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理信息神经PDE求解器参数虽随训练调整，但表示结构固定不变，而PDE解在空间与时空上复杂度高度异质，导致物理复杂处容量不足、简单处冗余。

Method: 提出物理信息神经可塑性范式，并实例化为ReCAP：高斯局部化求解器，通过局部增强、残差导向分裂、门控剪枝与函数感知合并动态重分配容量；用责任加权误差指标与残差能量几何决定精化位置；提出"quiet-child"精化控制分裂扰动；建立条件性后验可靠性与结构稳定性保证。

Result: 在5个高难度3D与4D PDE基准上对比11个物理信息求解器，每个问题均取得最低相对L2误差，较最强基线降低10.7%–27.5%。

Conclusion: 物理信息求解器不必仅学习参数，还可学习如何组织其表示容量。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural PDE solvers adapt their parameters to satisfy governing equations, yet their representational structure typically remains fixed throughout training. This rigidity is poorly matched to PDE solutions with strongly heterogeneous complexity across space and space--time, leaving capacity insufficient where the physics is difficult and redundant where it is simple. We introduce physics-informed neural plasticity, a paradigm in which the representation itself reshapes during optimization in response to unresolved physics. We instantiate this principle with Representation Capacity Adaptation for PDEs (ReCAP), a Gaussian-localized solver that dynamically redistributes capacity through local enrichment, residual-directed splitting, gate-based pruning, and function-aware merging. ReCAP uses responsibility-weighted error indicators and the geometry of residual energy to determine where and how to refine. To limit the disturbance introduced by splitting, we introduce quiet-child refinement, which initializes new components by transporting the parent representation while controlling instantaneous functional perturbation. We further establish conditional a posteriori reliability and structural-stability guarantees linking localized physics residuals to solution error and stable refinement. Across five challenging 3D and 4D PDE benchmarks against 11 physics-informed solvers, ReCAP achieves the lowest relative $L^2$ error on every problem, reducing error by $10.7\%$--$27.5\%$ relative to the strongest competing result. These results suggest that physics-informed solvers need not merely learn their parameters---they can learn how their representational capacity should be organized.

</details>


### [243] [Differential Refresh Policies for Models Trained on Lagging Data Snapshots: From a Single-Age Equivalence Limit to an Optimal Per-Segment Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09519)
*Amit Rajula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，对“全局训练数据年龄”做静态单调加权的刷新触发器等价于统一年龄定时器，因此应放弃全局陈旧度评分，转而按段差异化刷新，并按风险分配预算，从而在相同成本下降低陈旧暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的模型是训练快照的派生产物，其有效性随训练切点老去。常见做法是用带权重的全局陈旧度分数替代固定重训周期，但作者认为这是“错误的杠杆”，希望找到真正能改善模型刷新的机制。

Method: 首先证明等价性极限：任何仅依赖单一共享全局训练数据年龄的静态、严格单调刷新触发器，都与一个校准后的统一年龄定时器操作等价。由此提出按段差异化刷新，使每段拥有独立年龄与刷新间隔，并求解预算分配问题；采用频繁刷新近似得到最优刷新率与风险的平方根关系，并用离散事件仿真验证。

Result: 在频繁刷新区间，每段最优刷新率正比于其风险 w_j λ_j 的平方根；最优策略成本不高于统一定时器，并可用Cauchy-Schwarz形式的“统一代价”闭式表达，该代价在异质工作负载下增大。仿真中，在相同刷新预算下，最优策略将加权陈旧暴露降低8–29%，在86–100%的随机种子中胜出；简单暴露阈值策略没有这种效果，且优势在50%速率估计噪声下仍存在。

Conclusion: 模型刷新的关键杠杆不是更精细的全局陈旧度评分，而是更合理的刷新动作，即按段差异化、按风险平方根分配刷新预算。

Abstract: Production machine-learning models are derived artifacts of time-bounded training snapshots: a deployed model is a materialized view over a training cut that ages the instant it is built. A common response is to replace the fixed retraining cadence with an adaptive trigger -- a weighted staleness score that retrains when accumulated source risk crosses a threshold. We show this is the wrong lever, and identify the right one. First, an equivalence limit: any refresh trigger that is a static, strictly monotone function of a single shared global training-data age is operationally equivalent to a calibrated uniform age timer, so a global staleness budget, however elaborately it weights segments, sources, and sensitivities, carries no scheduling information a clock does not. The limit also shows how to escape it: refresh segments differentially, giving each its own age and refresh interval, which is meaningful when refresh cost is separable across segments (incremental training or per-segment models). We solve the resulting budget-allocation problem. In the frequent-refresh regime each segment's optimal refresh rate is proportional to the square root of its risk $w_j λ_j$ (weight times change rate), and the optimal policy never costs more than the uniform timer, beating it by a closed-form Cauchy-Schwarz "price of uniformity" that is zero for homogeneous workloads and grows with heterogeneity. In a discrete-event simulation with real Poisson change events, the optimal policy lowers realized weighted stale exposure by 8-29% relative to the uniform timer at matched refresh budget, winning on 86-100% of seeds; a naive exposure-threshold policy does not, showing the allocation is what helps; and the advantage survives 50% rate-estimation noise. The leverage in model refresh is not a better score but a better action.

</details>


### [244] [Align Before You Combine: Reference Space Calibration for Supervision Without Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09525)
*Jackson Eshbaugh,Jorge Silveyra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种"校准优先"框架，在无真值标签、无共享标注空间的条件下，通过合成序数参考空间对齐不同子集的评分器，从而生成监督分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在缺乏真值标签且各子集标注空间不一致的场景下，传统评分器输出不可比，简单平均融合效果不佳，需要一种能对齐异构评分器并生成监督分数的通用方法。

Method: 先用代表潜在概念的有序校准特征构建合成序数参考空间，将各子集特定评分器映射并对齐到该统一尺度，再进行融合。该校准过程依赖参考空间而非训练样本，因而独立于训练集的经验分布。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上一致优于未校准平均，并在主指标点估计上超过最优单一评分器；与依赖样本的基线相比差异随领域变化，Ames Housing 绝对差小于0.02，Breast Cancer Wisconsin 与 Wine Quality 小于0.01；Bonferroni 校正后，Ames Housing 三个比较及 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 一个比较仍显著。此外，减少每个特征的校准层级可在显著降低计算成本的同时逼近高分辨率结果。

Conclusion: 该框架是在既无真值标签又无共享标注空间时构建监督分数的一种可行方案。

Abstract: We introduce a calibration-first framework that produces supervision scores without access to ground-truth labels or a shared annotation space. Our framework aligns subset-specific scorers using a synthetic ordinal reference space before fusion. This reference space is constructed from ordered calibration features that represent the latent concept, providing a common scale on which otherwise incomparable scorer outputs can be aligned. Because our calibration procedure uses the reference space rather than training samples, it is independent of the training set's empirical distribution. Across three benchmark datasets, our framework consistently outperforms uncalibrated averaging and achieves higher primary-metric point estimates on the evaluation metrics than the best individual scorer. Performance relative to sample-dependent baselines varies by domain, with absolute differences below 0.02 on Ames Housing and below 0.01 on Breast Cancer Wisconsin and Wine Quality. After Bonferroni correction, differences remain significant for all three comparisons on Ames Housing and one on Breast Cancer Wisconsin. Additionally, we show that using fewer calibration levels per feature can closely approximate higher-resolution results at substantially lower computational cost. Together, these results support our framework as a viable approach to construct supervision scores when neither ground-truth labels nor a shared annotation space is available.

</details>


### [245] [CircuitGate: Logic-Consistent Circuit-Level Functional Modeling for And-Inverter Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09549)
*Qifan Zhang,Ruijie Li,Fangzhou Zhang,Qian Ma,Hui Li,Furui Zhan,Yongpeng Wang,Liying Hao,Shikai Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 CircuitGate，一个函数感知的 AIG 表示学习框架，通过编码全局 PI support、建模 support-overlap 感知的重汇聚并引入逻辑启发的布尔约束，从门级语义提升到电路级功能建模，在多个基准和任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIG 是 EDA 中逻辑综合与验证的基础表示，需要模型捕捉超越局部结构的功能依赖并对保功能变换保持稳健。现有基于 GNN 的方法主要依赖门级局部消息传递，难以捕捉电路级功能上下文，学到的表示对拓扑特定模式敏感。

Method: 提出 CircuitGate 函数感知 AIG 表示学习框架：显式编码全局主输入（PI）support；建模扇入之间 support-overlap 感知的重汇聚；融入逻辑启发的布尔约束以促使功能一致的表示。

Result: 在 ForgeEDA 大规模基准上评估，并在 EPFL 与 ITC'99 上验证。在等价门识别和信号概率预测任务上持续优于现有方法，MAE 分别最高降低 21.7% 和 14.2%。在无微调的 ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC 直接迁移下也取得最佳等价门识别性能，显示强跨数据集泛化能力。

Conclusion: 结果证明建模超越局部拓扑的电路级功能依赖是有效的。

Abstract: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) are fundamental representations for logic synthesis and verification in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). As structured representations of complex digital systems, AIGs require models to capture functional dependencies beyond local structure and remain robust to functionality-preserving transformations. In learning-based AIG representation, existing approaches are predominantly based on GNNs and rely on local gate-level message passing, limiting their ability to capture circuit-level functional context and making the learned representations sensitive to topology-specific patterns. Therefore, we propose CircuitGate, a function-aware AIG representation learning framework that advances from gate-level semantics to circuit-level functional modeling. CircuitGate explicitly encodes global primary-input (PI) support and models support-overlap-aware reconvergence between fanins, while incorporating logic-inspired Boolean constraints to encourage functionally consistent representations. We evaluate CircuitGate on the large-scale ForgeEDA benchmark and further validate it on the EPFL and ITC'99 benchmarks. Across equivalent-gate identification and signal-probability prediction tasks, CircuitGate consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 21.7% and 14.2% reductions in MAE, respectively. Under direct ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC transfer without fine-tuning, CircuitGate also achieves the best equivalent-gate identification performance, demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of modeling circuit-level functional dependencies beyond local topology.

</details>


### [246] [A Framework for the Systematic Review of ML Assets in AI Registries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09551)
*Alexandra González,Quim Motger,Xavier Franch,Silverio Martínez-Fernández*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将系统综述方法引入机器学习资产检索，提出面向AI注册库的结构化检索框架，使ML资产选择透明、可复现且基于证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件系统日益依赖预训练模型、数据集、基准等ML资产，但当前ML资产的探索、选择与复用缺乏像传统证据综述那样系统化的检索方法，实践中多凭非正式理由将其视为既定设计决策，缺乏可追溯、可更新、基于证据的选取过程。

Method: 借鉴科学文献中成熟的系统综述实践，将其规划、执行与记录等阶段适配到AI注册库中，把ML资产作为一等分析单元，构建整合注册库感知检索策略、跨注册库模式对齐与依赖驱动的资产探索框架。

Result: 将ML资产检索概念化为系统化、可复现的过程而非临时性活动，并提出了支持结构化ML资产发现的框架。

Conclusion: 本工作表明系统综述原则可超越科学文献范畴，用于支持对不断演化的AI注册库进行证据综合。

Abstract: Background: Modern software systems increasingly rely on Machine Learning (ML) assets (i.e., pre-trained models, datasets, benchmarks) for building, evaluating, and integrating ML-based systems. However, current exploration, selection and reuse practices of ML assets are not supported by systematic retrieval methodologies comparable to those used in traditional evidence synthesis. Consequently, in practice, ML asset selection is often presented as a settled design decision, supported by informal justification rather than a traceable, evidence-based, and updatable selection process. Aims: This paper explores how systematic review methods can support ML asset retrieval. In doing so, we aim to make their selection transparent and reproducible, grounded in explicit evidence, and ultimately better suited to its intended use. Method: We analyze established systematic review practices from scientific literature and adapt their phases (i.e., planning, conducting, and documenting) to Artificial Intelligence (AI) registries, treating ML assets as first-class units of analysis. The resulting framework integrates registry-aware search strategies, cross-registry schema alignment, and dependency-driven ML asset exploration. Results: We conceptualize ML asset retrieval as a systematic and reproducible process rather than an ad hoc activity, and propose a framework for structured ML asset discovery. \textbf{Conclusions:} This work illustrates how systematic review principles can be extended beyond scientific literature to support evidence synthesis over evolving AI registries.

</details>


### [247] [UniCSI Towards a Universal Wi-Fi CSI Encoder for Ubiquitous Human Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09559)
*Daniel Eckhoff,Hua Kang,Zhitang Chen,Jie Chuai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniCSI 提出统一基础架构，直接处理异构 Wi-Fi CSI，通过物理感知 RF tokenizer 与频谱聚合器实现跨设备、跨配置的感知建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi 感知可利用环境中的无线信号进行人体感知，但 CSI 采集受设备配置影响（子载波数、带宽、频段不同），导致 CSI 张量的频谱分辨率和形状异构，现成架构难以统一建模，只能做有损预处理，损害原始信号完整性。

Method: UniCSI 包含两项核心创新：(1) 物理感知 RF tokenizer，依据每个频率通道在物理频谱中的相对位置而非固定数组索引进行编码，保留频谱相干性，支持与频率分辨率无关的任意配置处理；(2) 频谱聚合器，将变长通道序列蒸馏为固定大小频谱签名，解耦特征维度与物理子载波间距。

Result: 在 25 个异构公开数据集、14 至 2048 个子载波、20 至 160 MHz 带宽、2.4 和 5 GHz 频段的大规模语料上评估，原生异构输入在监督和自监督训练下均显著提升跨域迁移，尤其在固定网格架构无法泛化的场景中表现更优。

Conclusion: UniCSI 通过保留原生波形完整性并统一处理异构 CSI，为 Wi-Fi 感知提供了可跨设备配置泛化的基础架构，验证了原生异构建模优于有损预处理和固定网格方法。

Abstract: Wi-Fi sensing promises to turn the everyday wireless signals that already surround us into ubiquitous sensors for human sensing. However, a fundamental obstacle is that CSI is acquired under diverse device-specific configurations, including different subcarrier counts, bandwidths, and carrier bands. Consequently, the resulting CSI tensors vary in both spectral resolution and tensor shape, making heterogeneous modeling challenging. Standard architectures struggle with such heterogeneity, forcing lossy pre-processing which compromises the underlying signal. To bridge this gap, we present UniCSI, a unified foundation architecture that directly operates on heterogeneous CSI while preserving the integrity of the native waveform. UniCSI hinges on two core innovations: (1) a physics-informed RF tokenizer that encodes each frequency channel based on its fractional position within the physical spectrum rather than rigid array indices. It preserves intrinsic spectral coherence and enables seamless, frequency resolution-agnostic processing across arbitrary sensing configurations. (2) a spectral aggregator that distills variable-length channel sequences into a fixed-size spectral signature, effectively decoupling the feature dimensionality from the physical subcarrier spacing. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale corpus of 25 heterogeneous public datasets, spanning 14 to 2048 subcarriers, 20 to 160 MHz bandwidth, and the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands, demonstrate that native heterogeneous ingestion substantially improves cross-domain transfer under both supervised and self-supervised training schemes, particularly in regimes where fixed-grid architectures fail to generalize.

</details>


### [248] [EvoSignal: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Design of Modular Traffic Signal Control Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09563)
*Leizhen Wang,Peibo Duan,Zhenlin Qin,Yancheng Ling,Jian Xu,Yue Wang,Hao Wang,Zhenliang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoSignal，将交通信号控制（TSC）建模为模块化程序设计问题，利用LLM引导的进化框架结合交通知识与性能反馈来自动改进控制程序，所得程序无需在线LLM推理。在两个真实路网五个场景的仿真中，默认程序相比20个基线最优等待时间降低16.8–49.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSC策略难以适应变化的交通需求与路网条件，且适配新策略常需反复人工设计与调整，难以系统探索更优控制规则。直接用LLM选择信号相位会将决策规则埋入黑箱模型，并带来持续的推理成本与延迟。

Method: 将TSC形式化为模块化程序设计问题：模块化表示将交通特征提取、局部相位优先级排序以及可选的基于网络的优先级调整相分离。以若干已有策略为起点，EvoSignal借助交通知识与拥堵、信号运行等性能反馈进行LLM引导的进化，保留具有不同性能权衡的策略，最终程序运行时不依赖在线LLM推理。

Result: 在两个真实路网、五个场景的仿真中，选定的默认EvoSignal程序相比每个场景中20个传统、强化学习及LLM基线所达到的最低等待时间，进一步降低16.8–49.2%。在搜索场景中，一个以行程时间与排队长度为优先的程序在全部三项指标上优于全部20个基线；将其原样迁移到其余四个场景时，每项指标仍保持前三。

Conclusion: 结果支持可检视控制程序的自动化设计，且这类程序在所评估的路网与交通需求间具有可迁移性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Effective traffic signal control (TSC) requires policies that respond to changing traffic demand and network conditions while meeting different control objectives. However, adapting existing strategies often involves repeated manual design and adjustment, making it difficult to systematically explore better control rules for a target network. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but directly using them to select signal phases leaves decision rules embedded in black-box models and incurs recurring inference costs and latency. This paper formulates TSC as a modular program design problem and proposes EvoSignal, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework using traffic knowledge and performance feedback. The modular representation separates traffic feature extraction, local phase prioritization, and optional network-based priority adjustment. Starting from several established strategies, EvoSignal improves programs through feedback on congestion and signal operation, retaining strategies with different performance trade-offs. The resulting programs operate without online LLM inference. Simulation experiments across five scenarios on two real-world road networks show that the selected default EvoSignal program reduces waiting time by 16.8--49.2\% relative to the lowest waiting time achieved by the 20 conventional, reinforcement learning-based, and LLM-based baselines in each scenario. A program prioritizing travel time and queue length outperforms all 20 baselines on all three metrics in the search scenario and remains among the top three on each metric when transferred unchanged to the other four scenarios. These findings support automated design of inspectable control programs that transfer across the evaluated road networks and traffic demands.Code is available at https://github.com/georgewanglz2019/EvoSignal.

</details>


### [249] [Online Resource Allocation with an Endogenous Markov State: Fewer LP Solves Earn More](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09577)
*Zhaohua Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究带内生马尔可夫状态的有限期在线资源分配：在已知请求先验下，频繁与不频繁重求解在非退化且不可约时均达O(1)后悔；退化时频繁重求解可能更差、Ω(T)，不频繁为Θ(√T)；未知先验下提出三阶段U形不频繁重求解策略，仅需O(log log T)次LP求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线资源分配中动作会影响未来状态与资源消耗，需理解重求解频率（频繁vs不频繁）如何影响性能，以及未知请求先验下如何协调学习与库存校正。

Method: 构建瞬态流体LP上界与平稳LP随机状态依赖控制；假设平稳LP唯一最优，引入原始非退化与最优诱导核不可约性；分别分析已知先验下频繁/不频繁重求解；未知先验下设计三阶段U形不频繁重求解策略，结合阈值与库存校正。

Result: 已知先验：非退化且不可约时两者O(1)；退化最优且不可约时，不频繁重求解最坏Θ(√T)，频繁重求解可Ω(T)。未知先验：给定最优目标状态类与常数成本进入策略时，非退化O(1)、退化O(√T)；无目标类信息则线性极小极大后悔不可避免。实验显示逐轮重求解不稳定、阈值缓解损失、不频繁方案占优。

Conclusion: 更频繁的优化未必更优，甚至渐近更差；不频繁重求解在已知/估计先验下均具优势；未知先验下目标状态类信息对实现次线性后悔至关重要。

Abstract: We study finite-horizon online resource allocation with i.i.d. requests and an endogenous Markov state on a finite state space: each action affects the transition of the state that governs future rewards and resource consumption. In this problem, a transient fluid LP benchmark upper bounds the expected reward of every nonanticipating policy, while a stationary LP supplies randomized state-dependent controls. We assume that the stationary LP has a unique optimum and identify primal nondegeneracy and irreducibility of the optimal induced kernel as important regularity conditions in this framework. With a known request prior, we show that, under nondegeneracy and irreducibility, both frequent and infrequent re-solving attain $O(1)$ regret. However, under a degenerate optimum, irreducibility yields the sharp worst-case $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ rate for infrequent re-solving, while frequent re-solving can incur $Ω(T)$ regret. Thus, more frequent optimization can perform asymptotically worse. With an unknown request prior, we develop a three-phase U-shaped infrequent re-solving policy that coordinates learning and inventory correction with $O(\log\log T)$ LP solves. When the optimal induced kernel is irreducible and the algorithm is given the optimal target state class and a constant-cost entrance policy, it attains $O(1)$ regret under nondegeneracy and $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret under degeneracy. Without the target-class information, linear minimax regret is unavoidable. Numerical experiments further illustrate the instability of round-by-round re-solving relative to epoch-wise infrequent re-solving, show that thresholding greatly mitigates its loss, and find that infrequent schemes remain dominant under both known and estimated priors.

</details>


### [250] [Collaborative Reasoning Distillation via Cross-Feedback and Coherent Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09587)
*Taehoon Kim,Seunggeun Cho,Dongsu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出协作推理蒸馏框架CRD，通过教师交叉反馈、细粒度步骤质量评估与连贯性感知步骤拼接，结合预算约束的推理质量优化训练紧凑模型，CRD-4B以极少数据在数学推理任务上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升大语言模型推理能力常需巨大算力，或将推理能力蒸馏到小模型又效果不佳。传统蒸馏依赖结果奖励，无法区分真实合理推理与侥幸猜对，因此需要更关注推理过程质量的方法。

Method: CRD包含三项创新：(1) 交互式交叉反馈，教师相互迭代批判推理过程；(2) 细粒度逐步质量评估，捕捉独立于最终答案的逻辑有效性；(3) 连贯性感知的步骤拼接，融合互补优势。学生模型通过带预算约束的推理质量优化RQO进行训练。

Result: CRD-4B在MATH-500上达到97.3%，在AIME'25上达到70.3%，超过多个基线，且仅使用5万条训练样本，比同类模型数据集小最多12倍。

Conclusion: 过程导向的协作推理蒸馏与质量优化能高效提升小模型推理能力，实现数据与算力效率的双重优势。

Abstract: Reasoning capabilities are critical for advancing Large Language Models, yet current approaches either require massive computational budgets or struggle to effectively distill reasoning to smaller models. Standard distillation methods rely on outcome-based rewards, failing to distinguish between sound reasoning and lucky guesses. We propose Collaborative Reasoning Distillation (CRD), a framework that enhances reasoning in compact models through three innovations: (1) interactive cross-feedback where teachers iteratively critique each other's reasoning, (2) fine-grained step-wise quality assessment capturing logical validity independent of final answers, and (3) coherence-aware step stitching that synthesizes complementary strengths. Students are trained via Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) with budget constraints. Our model, CRD-4B, achieves 97.3% on MATH-500 and 70.3% on AIME'25, surpassing baselines while using only 50K training examples, up to 12 times smaller than the datasets of comparable models.

</details>


### [251] [COPC: Coupled Off-Policy Correction for Asynchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09597)
*Zicheng Hu,Zhijian Zhou,Xuan Zhang,Yuchen Liu,Cheng Chen,Yuan Li,Qi Gu,Yan Feng,Hongyan Hao,Chao Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出耦合离策略校正方法COPC，协调策略侧与优势侧校正，缓解异步RL中的优势陈旧问题，提升性能与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步RL通过解耦rollout与优化加速LLM后训练，但训练于陈旧轨迹上。现有方法仅在actor目标中用重要性比率控制来校正token级策略失配，作者指出这种策略侧校正不足，因为优势估计也继承了行为策略延续带来的失配，即优势陈旧问题。

Method: 推导一般双通道actor更新的精确偏差与方差分解，揭示策略权重与优势估计误差的不可分耦合。据此提出COPC（Couped Off-Policy Correction），一种actor-critic方法，结合token级比率掩码与对TD残差的双侧裁剪比率加权，用于回报和优势估计。

Result: 在不同陈旧程度下的联合参数扫描支持该假设：一个校正参数的效果依赖于另一个，且可能随其反转。COPC在工具集成数学推理与搜索上取得最高报告性能，超过最强异步基线，具备宽广的高性能参数区间和更好的训练稳定性。在搜索中COPC全程稳定，而多数异步基线训练后期崩溃。增益在64步策略陈旧下仍保持，步骤时间开销极小，相比同步PPO保持1.7倍加速。

Conclusion: 策略侧与优势侧校正应协同进行，COPC通过耦合校正有效解决异步RL中的优势陈旧，兼顾性能、稳定性与效率。

Abstract: Asynchronous RL accelerates large language model post-training by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but trains on stale trajectories. Existing methods primarily correct token-level policy mismatch through importance-ratio control in the actor objective. We show that this \emph{policy-side correction} alone is insufficient: advantage estimates also inherit mismatch from behavior-policy continuations, which we term \emph{advantage staleness}. We derive exact bias and variance decompositions for a general two-channel actor update, revealing nonseparable coupling between policy-weight and advantage-estimation errors: their interaction induces multiplicative bias terms, while squared policy weights amplify advantage uncertainty in gradient variance. This motivates the hypothesis that policy- and advantage-side correction should be coordinated. We introduce Coupled Off-Policy Correction (COPC), an actor--critic method combining token-level ratio masking with two-sided clipped-ratio weighting of TD residuals for return and advantage estimation. Joint parameter sweeps across staleness levels support this hypothesis: the effect of one correction parameter depends on, and can reverse with, the other. COPC achieves the highest reported performance on tool-integrated mathematical reasoning and search, outperforming the strongest reported asynchronous baseline in each setting. It also offers a broad high-performing parameter region and improved training stability. In search, COPC remains stable throughout training, while most evaluated asynchronous baselines collapse late in training. These gains persist at 64-step policy staleness. COPC adds minimal step-time overhead over asynchronous PPO and retains a $1.7\times$ step-time speedup over synchronous PPO.

</details>


### [252] [Lightweight and Versatile Learned Optimization by Recombination of Gradient History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09604)
*Minyoung Choi,Dalta Imam Maulana,Wanyeong Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量且通用的学习型优化器，通过对不重叠时间段上的梯度历史进行动态重组（每个梯度平均仅用一个共享标量系数），实现零样本泛化到未见任务，并以极低计算开销超越Adam。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型优化器通常在较大的预测空间中进行学习，导致训练成本高、泛化能力有限，且难以在长梯度历史与低内存开销之间取得平衡。本文旨在设计一个参数量小、训练高效、能零样本泛化到多种任务的通用优化器。

Method: 将梯度历史表示为不重叠时间段上的平均值，并动态重新组合；把预测空间简化为每个梯度平均对应一个标量系数，且该系数由多个参数共享；对较旧的梯度采用渐进式平均，以降低长历史的内存开销，同时保持各历史贡献可独立访问。

Result: 一个37k参数的网络在0.87 GPU小时内完成训练后即可零样本泛化到未见任务：在BERT-Tiny和GPT-Tiny上分别降低验证损失9.1%和0.4%；在Vision Transformer上相比Adam提升测试准确率3.5个百分点，在九个图模型上平均提升2.7个百分点；FLOPs开销低至0.3%。

Conclusion: 该优化器以极小的参数量与训练成本实现了强泛化能力和稳定性能提升，且计算开销可忽略，展示了作为通用、轻量级学习型优化器的实用性。

Abstract: This paper presents a lightweight and versatile learned optimizer that dynamically recombines gradient history, represented as averages over disjoint time spans. The optimizer reduces the prediction space to one scalar coefficient per gradient average, shared by multiple parameters. Progressively averaging older gradients minimizes memory cost of long history, while keeping their contributions independently accessible. A 37k-parameter network trained in 0.87 GPU-hours generalizes zero-shot to unseen tasks, lowering validation loss by 9.1% and 0.4% on BERT-Tiny and GPT-Tiny, and improving test accuracy over Adam by 3.5 %p on a Vision Transformer and by 2.7 %p on average across nine graph models, with FLOPs overhead as low as 0.3%.

</details>


### [253] [Decoupled Optimization for Teacher-Student Semi-Supervised Learning via a Pioneer Student](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09609)
*Haorong Han,Jidong Yuan,Chixuan Wei,Yongqi Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PiS（Pioneer Student）辅助分支，通过独立参数空间缓解半监督学习中教师-学生参数耦合与标注/无标注损失梯度不平衡两大优化病理，作为即插即用模块提升主流SSL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半监督学习依赖教师-学生自训练和标注/无标注联合优化两大机制，但二者存在优化病理：一是参数耦合强制教师与学生严格同步，学生上的强正则化削弱教师拟合能力，限制可允许的泛化强度；二是标注与无标注损失的梯度更新一致性不平衡，使共享参数过早收敛至标注主导的局部极小值，形成全局优化瓶颈。

Method: 提出Pioneer Student（PiS）辅助分支，该分支运行于独立参数空间，并周期性地将积累的知识迁移回教师-学生模型，从而解耦参数、缓解梯度不平衡问题。

Result: 大量实验表明，PiS是一个通用的即插即用模块，能够持续提升主流半监督学习方法的效果。

Conclusion: 通过引入独立参数空间的辅助分支并周期性知识回传，可有效解决SSL中教师-学生参数耦合与梯度不平衡导致的优化瓶颈，且具有通用性与易集成性。

Abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) relies on two core mechanisms: self-training under the Teacher-Student (T-S) framework and joint optimization of labeled and unlabeled losses. Despite their effectiveness, we find both mechanisms introduce distinct optimization pathologies. First, parameter coupling enforces strict synchronization between teacher and student, where strong regularization on the student degrades the teacher's fitting ability, thereby limiting the permissible generalization intensity. Second, the imbalance in gradient update consistency between labeled and unlabeled losses drives the shared parameters to prematurely converge to labeled-dominated local minima, creating a bottleneck for global optimization. To address both issues, we propose the Pioneer Student (PiS), an auxiliary branch that operates in an independent parameter space and periodically transfers accumulated knowledge back to the T-S model. Extensive experiments show that PiS is a universal plug-and-play module that consistently improves mainstream SSL methods.

</details>


### [254] [Sequential Pretraining Favors Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09611)
*Mohnish Harwani,Yujia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文定义并量化了"首位偏置"（primacy bias）——早期数据分布损害后期学习的程度，发现小模型会低效地将学习容量分配给早期分布，而大模型对此具有鲁棒性；为此提出"暴露疗法"（Exposure Therapy, ET）正则化方法，提升顺序预训练中后期数据的学习效率与整体能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大神经网络具备小模型学不会的能力，其原因尚不明确：究竟是大模型学到了更具代表性的特征，还是大模型对训练中引入的某些不利效应更鲁棒？作者希望厘清这一机制，并找出可迁移到小模型的改进方向。

Method: 作者定义并量化了一种不利效应——首位偏置（primacy bias），即早期数据分布的暴露对后续学习的损害程度。通过在顺序预训练中观察不同规模模型的学习容量分配情况来验证该效应，并提出 Exposure Therapy (ET)，一种简单正则化方法，用于促进顺序预训练期间学习容量的更高效分配。

Result: 小模型会将学习容量低效地分配给早期数据分布，而充分过参数化的模型对此效应具有鲁棒性。这种低效在预训练中尤为关键：小规模基础模型难以学习训练后期出现的分布，尤其当后期数据强调代码、数学和推理等能力时危害更大。ET 能提升基础模型在后期数据分布上的表现，并改善参数量达十亿级别模型的整体能力。

Conclusion: 大基础模型的某些优势可能源于对不利训练效应更强的鲁棒性，而非学到更具代表性的特征；且改进的训练算法可以帮助较小模型恢复部分这类优势。

Abstract: Large neural networks often acquire capabilities that small models fail to learn. Does this stem from large models learning more representative features, or from being more robust to unaccounted-for adverse effects introduced during training? We define and quantify one such adverse effect, primacy bias, as the extent to which exposure to early data distributions impairs later learning. We show that small models can allocate learning capacity inefficiently toward early distributions, whereas sufficiently overparameterized models are robust to this effect. This inefficiency is particularly consequential in pretraining, where foundation models often encounter heterogeneous data distributions sequentially rather than jointly. As a result, small foundation models can struggle to learn distributions encountered late in training, which is particularly harmful when later data emphasizes desirable capabilities such as code, mathematics, and reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Exposure Therapy (ET), a simple regularization that promotes more efficient allocation of learning capacity during sequential pretraining. We demonstrate that ET improves foundation models' performance on late data distributions as well as overall capability in models up to the billion-parameter scale. Overall, our results suggest that some benefits of large foundation models may arise from greater robustness to adverse training effects, rather than from learning more representative features, and that improved training algorithms can recover some of these advantages in smaller models.

</details>


### [255] [The Identifiability and Observability of Deep Normalized Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09620)
*Pranav Venkata Konda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度、未掩码、单头注意力中哪些参数由其输入-输出函数决定。对已知正的非恒定实解析归一化器，函数在一般情况下确定有效得分与组合值映射，至多相差由偶归一化器引起的符号。这证明了 Henry–Marchetti–Kohn 猜想在实解析情形（含 softmax）下的正确性，并进一步分类例外纤维、刻画坍缩导致后续得分不可观测的条件，给出局部可识别性的精确 Taylor 阶；在查询/键同时坍缩附近，计算了分离有限输入库上的完整原生 Jacobian 衰减谱，并对常见首个非恒定归一化器次数 k，指出第 i 层接触阶为 2k3^{i-1}-1 及相应重数与核维数，最后用高精度与自动微分实验展示数值敏感性损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解深度注意力模型中参数的可识别性：即哪些参数真正由网络的输入-输出行为决定，哪些参数存在不可观测或等价变换的自由度。这关系到注意力机制的理论基础、模型可解释性以及训练中数值稳定性问题。

Method: 针对深度、未掩码、单头注意力，在正的非恒定实解析归一化器条件下，从输入-输出函数出发分析参数决定关系；证明有效得分与组合值映射在一般情形下被确定（至偶归一化器诱导的符号）；分类显式归一化器条件下的例外纤维；推导局部识别的精确 Taylor 阶；在查询/键同时坍缩附近计算原生 Jacobian 衰减谱；并结合高精度计算与自动微分进行数值验证。

Result: 证明了 Henry–Marchetti–Kohn 猜想在实解析情形（包括 softmax）下成立；分类了例外纤维并识别出坍缩使后续得分不可观测的情形；建立了尖锐的局部识别 Taylor 阶；在同时查询/键坍缩附近得到完整的原生 Jacobian 衰减谱；对常见首个非恒定归一化器次数 k，发现第 i 层接触阶为 2k3^{i-1}-1，并给出精确重数与核维数；数值实验展示了由此导致的数值敏感性损失。

Conclusion: 深度单头注意力的参数可识别性在实解析归一化器下具有结构性规律：一般情形下有效得分与组合值映射可被确定，但存在由偶归一化器与坍缩导致的例外和不可观测性，且随层数加深呈现指数级接触阶与 Jacobian 衰减，造成显著的数值敏感性损失。

Abstract: We study which parameters of deep, unmasked, single-head attention are determined by its input--output function. For known positive nonconstant real-analytic normalizers, the function generically determines the effective scores and combined value map up to the signs induced by even normalizers. This proves the real-analytic case of a conjecture of Henry--Marchetti--Kohn, including softmax. We then classify exceptional fibers under explicit normalizer conditions, identifying when collapse makes later scores unobservable, and establish sharp Taylor orders for local identification. Near simultaneous query/key collapse, we compute the complete native Jacobian decay spectrum on separating finite input banks. For common first nonconstant normalizer degree $k$, layer $i$ has contact order $2k3^{i-1}-1$, with exact multiplicities and kernel dimension. High-precision and automatic differentiation calculations illustrate the resulting loss of numerical sensitivity.

</details>


### [256] [When does a network's training history predict its future learning better than its current state? Evidence from a response probe and a forecasting screen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09621)
*Martin Hofmann,Patrick Mäder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究探讨神经网络的训练历史能否比其当前状态更好地预测未来学习，通过大规模MLP实验（42种历史）和1560次合成回归测试进行检验，发现在当前状态尚未包含目标信息时历史才有预测价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有关于可塑性丧失和关键期的研究表明训练路径会影响后续学习，但这并未证明训练路径蕴含当前状态测量所遗漏的信息。本文旨在检验：何时网络的训练历史能比其当前状态更好地预测其未来学习表现。

Method: 主研究训练小型多层感知机（三种历史机制、42种历史），在四个检查点用短探测（在新任务上训练100步的副本网络）测量未来学习能力，并在读取预测结果前校验探测协议（包括函数保持的隐藏单元重缩放、重复测量一致性、单元重新初始化）。用一个至多四维的历史状态与当前状态的校准模型作比较。另一项在1560次合成回归运行上的筛选实验，则针对更远的目标——运行的最终误差进行预测。

Result: 主研究中，至多四维的历史状态未能超越当前状态的校准模型（增益-21.4%，90%区间[-91.9, 8.1]，事先要求为10%）。探测协议表现良好：对函数保持重缩放单调响应，重复测量组内相关0.940（[0.903, 0.997]），单元重初始化可即时检测但100至200步后不可见。合成回归筛选中，历史模型在最多240个epoch中的12个之后优于当前验证误差预测（紧凑状态30.3%，[15.8, 39.4]），48个epoch后则无差异。

Conclusion: 在两项研究中，只有当当前状态尚未对目标具有信息价值时，训练历史才具有预测信息；一旦当前状态变得具有信息价值，历史便不再提供额外增益。这一解读是在结果形成之后得出的。

Abstract: Networks that behave alike now can still learn differently when training continues. Work on loss of plasticity and critical periods shows that the path to a state shapes what follows; it does not show whether the path carries information that a measurement of the state itself misses. We ask when the training history of a network predicts its future learning better than its current state. In a main study, small multilayer perceptrons were trained under three history regimes (42 histories), and future learning was measured at four checkpoints by a short probe: a copy of the network trained for 100 updates on a new task. Before the prediction result was read, the protocol checked the probe. It responded monotonically to a function-preserving rescaling of hidden units, repeated measurements agreed (intraclass correlation 0.940, [0.903, 0.997], in the least reliable class, mean of three repeats), and a re-initialisation of units was visible directly after it but not 100 to 200 updates later. A history state of at most four dimensions did not improve on a calibrated model of the current state (gain -21.4%, 90% interval [-91.9, 8.1]; required in advance: 10%). A companion screen on 1,560 synthetic regression runs asked the same question for a target further away, the final error of the run. There, history models forecast better than the current validation error after 12 of up to 240 epochs (compact state 30.3%, [15.8, 39.4], a contextual comparison) and were not distinguishable from it after 48. In both studies the history was informative only while the current state was not yet informative about the target; this reading was formed after the results.

</details>


### [257] [Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09633)
*Igor Slinko,Yaroslav Golubev,Sergey Titov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过采集JetBrains IDE中真实工程师的4,782个编码代理会话，揭示真实长会话与基准任务的差异，并提出SWE-TaskFlow方法来将基准任务校准至目标交互分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码代理评估追求尽可能真实，但基于issue衍生的基准任务与真实使用场景存在差异：真实用户请求涵盖任务类型更广（代码问答、规划、审查、重构、执行等），且在会话中会不断切换任务类型；而不同公开交互语料的长会话Task Flow差异显著，说明不存在普遍通用的交互分布，因此基准测试需要明确目标用例并据此校准。

Method: 研究者采集了JetBrains IDE中真实软件工程师的4,782个代理会话（Production Sessions），聚焦至少含三条用户消息的长会话（占样本33%），分析其Task Flow（会话长度、任务类型及类型间转换的分布）。在此基础上提出SWE-TaskFlow方法：保留已验证的任务与测试，通过prompt splitting和可验证的仓库QA将交互引导至目标Task Flow，并用TaskFlow Alignment Score（TFAS）在生成的轨迹中进行选择。

Result: 真实长会话与issue衍生基准任务存在两方面差异：任务类型混合更广、会话中类型不断切换；三个公开交互语料的长会话样本Task Flow差异明显，证明单一交互分布无法通用。在700个SWE-Bench Pro任务的试点中，将任务分多步顺序求解大约使代理成本翻倍，但解决率没有稳定变化。

Conclusion: 交互协议本身是评估的重要维度。基准测试应明确目标用例并据其校准交互分布，SWE-TaskFlow为此提供了一种可行方案，能够在不改变已验证任务和测试的前提下调整交互流程。

Abstract: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user messages (33% of the sample). These long sessions differ from issue-derived benchmark tasks in two ways: (i) user requests span a far wider mix of task types - questions about the project's code, planning, review, refactoring, execution - and (ii) users switch between types throughout a session. Long-session samples from three public interaction corpora exhibit markedly different Task Flows (the distributions of session lengths, task types, and type-to-type transitions), so no single interaction distribution is universally realistic: benchmarks should name a target use case and calibrate to measurements from it. We present SWE-TaskFlow, an approach for transforming any issue-derived benchmark: it preserves the verified tasks and tests while steering the interaction toward a target Task Flow through prompt splitting and verifiable repository QA, with a TaskFlow Alignment Score (TFAS) for selecting among generated trajectories. In a pilot on 700 SWE-Bench Pro tasks, solving the task sequentially in several steps approximately doubles agent cost without a stable change in resolve rate: the interaction protocol itself is an important dimension of evaluation.

</details>


### [258] [When Rank Rises as LLMs Degrade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09647)
*Zhaohui Geoffrey Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文表明，在LLM后训练中，谱监测指标（RankMe、协方差有效秩）与表示健康度的关系并非单向：数据重复会导致谱弥散并抬高RankMe，而学习率配置错误则降低centred RankMe；监测需两侧、多通道并使用留出健康数据校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中常用RankMe等谱统计量监测表示健康，默认“秩下降=表示退化”。论文指出这一假设在LLM后训练中不安全，需要验证方向性是否稳定、不同退化模式是否表现一致，以及谱监测能否比留出损失更早预警。

Method: 以Qwen3-0.6B为对象，设置四种退化模式、三个随机种子进行受控研究；对比原始与中心化RankMe、k95、协方差有效秩等统计量；并在预训练模型中间层原始状态上考察massive activations的影响。随后设计两侧、多通道序贯监测器，分离校准数据与测试数据，进行预注册的共享前缀、留一种子评估。

Result: 数据重复使留出损失相对健康基线恶化75%，同时抬高原始和中心化RankMe（后者变化达13.5个合并标准差），协方差有效秩升至健康值近两倍，属谱弥散而非坍缩，导致单侧监测把最差检查点评为最健康。学习率错误则降低中心化RankMe和k95，未中心化RankMe跨种子不一致。原始中间层状态中massive activations使协方差有效秩接近1/d，而RankMe仍有可用范围。序贯监测器能在分叉后10–60步内于每个折检出三种损伤，并按触发方向区分弥散与秩下降；但从不早于留出探针损失，且两种子校准会在留出健康种子上误报。

Conclusion: 谱监测能诊断失效模式，但不能比留出损失更早预警；其方向性是“机制—统计量”配对的属性，无法仅靠重校准修复；有效性主张必须依赖留出的健康数据进行校准，并采用两侧、多通道监测。

Abstract: Post-training adapts language models in non-stationary environments. Practitioners monitor representation health with RankMe and related spectral statistics, often assuming that rank falls when representations degrade. We show that this assumption is unsafe for LLM post-training. In a controlled study of Qwen3-0.6B with four degradation modes and three seeds, data duplication worsens held-out loss by 75% relative to healthy while increasing both original and centred RankMe; the latter changes by 13.5 pooled standard deviations. Covariance effective rank rises to nearly twice its healthy value. This failure is spectral dispersion rather than collapse, so a one-sided monitor rates the worst checkpoint as the healthiest. By contrast, a learning-rate misconfiguration lowers centred RankMe and k95, while uncentred RankMe is inconsistent across seeds. Direction is therefore a property of the regime-statistic pair and cannot be fixed by recalibration alone. We also distinguish two often-conflated statistics: RankMe normalises singular values, whereas covariance effective rank normalises eigenvalues. On raw intermediate-layer states in the pretrained model, massive activations pin the latter near 1 out of dimension d while RankMe retains usable range. We then test a two-sided, multichannel sequential monitor with separate calibration and test data. In a pre-registered shared-prefix, leave-one-seed-out evaluation, it detects all three damage regimes in every fold 10 to 60 steps after the fork and separates dispersion from downward-rank damage by firing direction. However, it never precedes held-out probe loss, and calibration with two seeds produces false alarms on the held-out healthy seed. Spectral monitoring can diagnose failure regimes, but it does not warn earlier than held-out loss, and validity claims require held-out healthy data.

</details>


### [259] [Closed-Form Noise Calibration Against Membership Inference for Random-Allocation DP-SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09651)
*Murat Bilgehan Ertan,Marten van Dijk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机分配的DP-SGD，给出一个一行公式上界任意成员推断攻击的精度，并用数值实验验证其紧致性与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP-SGD依赖数值隐私会计器搜索噪声量，过程耗时且缺乏可解释性。作者希望为随机分配的DP-SGD提供一个可解释、可快速计算的隐私上界，并评估其紧致程度。

Method: 针对每个epoch每条记录仅使用一次、并在随机步分配的DP-SGD，基于高斯分布与支配随机分配的高斯混合之间的卡方散度，推导出成员推断攻击精度的显式上界：½+¼√((1+(e^{1/σ²}−1)/M)^E−1)。同时推导这两种分布的精确攻击精度表达式用于数值校准。

Result: 该公式可在约一微秒内给出σ，在所适用场景中所需噪声最多约为最先进闭式上界的一半；校准到精确表达式可比公式再减少13.0%至20.2%的噪声。训练中所得σ优于公式并与某已发表会计器测试精度相当，数秒获得、数分钟认证，而该会计器每次搜索更慢或至少多0.62%噪声。

Conclusion: 该一行公式为随机分配DP-SGD提供了紧致、可解释且高效的隐私上界，训练模型上的成员推断攻击精度均低于该上界，且该方法在效率与噪声效率上优于现有数值会计器搜索。

Abstract: DP-SGD protects training data by adding Gaussian noise to clipped gradients. The amount of noise is usually chosen by running a numerical privacy accountant inside a search. We study DP-SGD with random allocation, where each epoch uses every record once, at a randomly chosen step. For this setting we give a one-line formula that bounds the accuracy of every membership inference attack (MIA) on the trained model. With $M$ steps per epoch, $E$ epochs and noise multiplier $σ$, and with membership and non-membership equally likely a priori, the attack accuracy is at most $\frac12+\frac14\sqrt{(1+(e^{1/σ^2}-1)/M)^E-1}$. The formula comes from the chi-square divergence between a Gaussian distribution and a Gaussian mixture that dominates random allocation. It is interpretable and gives $σ$ in about a microsecond. Where applicable, our formula needs at most about half the noise of the state-of-the-art closed-form bound. To measure how close the bound is, we also derive an exact expression for the attack accuracy of these two distributions and evaluate it numerically. Calibrating to this exact expression requires $13.0\%$ to $20.2\%$ less noise than the formula in our main experiments, and since it is exact, no accountant that knows only $M$, $E$ and $σ$ can certify a smaller $σ$. In training, the resulting $σ$ outperforms the formula and matches a published accountant in test accuracy. It is found in seconds and certified in minutes, whereas every search we ran with that accountant took longer or returned at least $0.62\%$ more noise. We show that MIAs on the trained models stay below the bound.

</details>


### [260] [DSTNet: Dynamic Spectral Trajectory Network for Causal Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09654)
*Aashish Bohra,Lokendra Vishwakarm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DSTNet通过单边Morlet滤波、因果动态谱轨迹与尺度-时间因子化Transformer，在多资产多步长预测中一致优于九个学习型基线与随机游走持续基准，但在一天步长对最强竞争者的配对检验不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有小波类金融预测方法仅把小波用于去噪，或把频谱压缩为预测起点处的单帧快照，且卷积多为双边，会"看到"预测起点之后的未来信息；同时多步长预测缺乏统一的因果谱动态建模。

Method: 构建因果Dynamic Spectral Trajectory：以七个滞后技术指标、二十日回看窗、单边Morlet滤波器组提取，并为左边界瞬态设显式burn-in。用因子化Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer分别在时间轴与滤波器组轴上做注意力，再用学习门控将其与CNN-BiLSTM融合，最后由按步长区分的门控一次性输出1/3/5/10日预测。在七个股票指数与黄金上采用统一扩展窗口协议及一年未触碰留出集评估。

Result: 在MAE与MAPE下，随机游走在32个"序列×步长"单元格中有29个为十个固定竞争者中最强；DSTNet是唯一在每个单元格都低于随机游走的模型，1日低0.7–0.9%，10日低3.4–4.5%。1日配对检验中DSTNet优于较弱学习基线，但与随机游走及最强学习预测器相比结论不确定。

Conclusion: 谱轨迹建模能稳定压低误差，但尚不足以在统计上显著超越持续基准；下游资产配置诊断未在七个指数上支持股票择时优势。

Abstract: Wavelet-based financial forecasters typically use the transform only to denoise, or reduce it to a single spectral snapshot at the forecast origin, and the convolution that produces the coefficients is usually bilateral, so it can read past the forecast origin. DSTNet instead retains the recent evolution of filter-bank magnitudes as a causal Dynamic Spectral Trajectory, built from seven trailing technical indicators over a twenty-day lookback with a one-sided Morlet-derived filter bank and an explicit burn-in for the left-boundary transient. A factorized Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer attends along the time and filter-bank axes separately, a learned gate fuses the spectral branch with a CNN-BiLSTM, and horizon-specific gates emit one, three, five, and ten day forecasts in a single pass. We evaluate seven equity indices and gold under a common expanding-window protocol and an untouched one-year hold-out, against nine learned baselines and a random-walk persistence benchmark. Under MAE and MAPE, persistence is the strongest of the ten fixed competitors in 29 of the 32 series-horizon cells and DSTNet is the only model below it in every cell, by 0.7 to 0.9 percent at one day and 3.4 to 4.5 percent at ten days. At one day, paired testing favours DSTNet against the weaker learned baselines but is inconclusive against persistence and the strongest learned forecasters. A downstream allocation diagnostic does not support an equity-timing advantage on any of the seven indices.

</details>


### [261] [Gauss-Newton Accuracy and Indefinite Hessians: Uniform Coexistence in Low-Cost Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09675)
*Kihun Rhee,Hanjoon Byun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究岭正则化非线性最小二乘中Gauss-Newton曲率的精度，证明了两种曲率状态的共存、全局极小值的存在性及相对Hessian误差上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是刻画岭正则化非线性最小二乘中Gauss-Newton近似曲率与真实Hessian之间的偏差，理解低代价集合内曲率行为的结构。

Method: 方法基于局部正则性与沿精确拟合截面的水平集曲率幅值持续性假设，使用逐点证书（基于当前预测水平集）控制Hessian修正的法向、混合与切向部分，并给出相对误差的尖锐界。

Result: 主要结果包括：证明两种曲率状态的均匀共存；全局极小值存在且其相对Hessian误差低于(1+√2)/8；同一低代价集合内存在不定Hessian点且相对误差至少15/8；一个正岭上界对所有扰动和岭权重成立且邻域不随岭权重趋于零而收缩；在给定逐点类上证明了尖锐相对误差界；另给出低代价集合上Jacobian满行秩及在秩亏参考附近精确插值的结构结果。

Conclusion: 结论表明Gauss-Newton曲率在岭正则化下可同时呈现良性误差与不定Hessian的不利情形，所给界与证书为分析曲率精度提供了定量工具。

Abstract: We study the accuracy of Gauss-Newton curvature in ridge-regularized nonlinear least squares. Under local regularity and persistence of level-set curvature magnitude along an exact-fit section, we prove uniform coexistence of two curvature regimes. Global minimizers exist, and every global minimizer has relative Hessian error below $(1+\sqrt2)/8$, while the same low-cost set contains a point with an indefinite Hessian and relative error at least $15/8$. One positive ridge cap works for all independent center and label perturbations in fixed neighborhoods and every positive ridge weight up to the cap. These neighborhoods do not shrink as the ridge weight tends to zero. A pointwise certificate based on the current prediction level set controls the normal, mixed, and tangent parts of the Hessian correction. We prove a sharp relative-error bound over the stated pointwise class when the prediction map and ridge vary. Analytic examples describe the roles of output alignment, curvature orientation, and persistence. A separate structural result gives full Jacobian row rank throughout low-cost sets and exact interpolation near a rank-deficient reference.

</details>


### [262] [CERO: Where and When to Allocate Rollouts for RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09679)
*Yiming Zong,Yige Wang,Xing Hu,Jiashuo Jiang,Zuo-Jun Max Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何在完整训练周期内协调有限的 rollout 预算，提出在线原始-对偶调度器 CERO，用于提示词准入与预算节奏控制，在多项数学推理基准上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组相对强化学习中的自适应 rollout 方法通常为每次更新在各提示词间分配固定预算，缺乏对整体训练周期有限预算的统筹协调，因此本文关注跨整个训练周期的预算协调问题。

Method: 以累积提示词曝光的凹代理效用建模该问题，提出 CERO：通过紧凑的 Fenchel 表示线性化对累积曝光的依赖，并用投影在线梯度下降更新提示词专属支撑斜率与共享预算价格，反馈来自奖励变化与预算偏差；每个被准入提示词获得固定规模响应组，CERO 自适应选择提示词、决定其跨轮重访频率及每轮生成组数。

Result: 在匹配训练响应预算下，CERO 在三个骨干模型、五个数学推理基准上均取得最高的 avg@16 宏平均；机制分析表明其提示词选择与组内奖励对比度相关，多种子消融显示自适应节奏优于均匀与预设支出计划。

Conclusion: 跨训练周期的自适应预算协调可有效提升组相对强化学习效果，CERO 在理论与实验上均展现出相对固定速率及同路径时变基准的路径级保证与性能优势。

Abstract: Adaptive rollout methods for group-relative reinforcement learning typically allocate a fixed per-update budget across prompts. We instead study how to coordinate a finite rollout budget over the entire training horizon. We formulate this problem using a concave surrogate utility of cumulative prompt exposure and introduce CERO, an online primal dual scheduler for prompt admission and budget pacing. In our experiments, each admitted prompt receives a fixed-size response group. CERO instead adapts which prompts are selected, how often they are revisited across rounds, and how many groups are generated in each round. A compact Fenchel representation linearizes the dependence on cumulative exposure, while projected online gradient descent updates prompt-specific supporting slopes and a shared budget price using reward-variation feedback and budget deviations. We establish pathwise guarantees for the surrogate allocation objective against fixed-rate and same-path time-varying benchmarks, with explicit terms for proxy discrepancy and rate variation. Under matched training-response budgets, CERO attains the highest avg@16 macro-average on each of three backbones across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Mechanistic analyses link CERO's prompt choices to within-group reward contrast, while multi-seed ablations show gains from adaptive pacing over both uniform and preset spending schedules.

</details>


### [263] [Few-Shot Learning for Personalised Automated Pain Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09692)
*Heinke Hihn,Ibrahim Eisawy,Patrick Thiam,Hans A. Kestler,Friedhelm Schwenker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估少样本学习（元学习子领域）用于自动疼痛评估中的个性化，将人群级到个体级评估的迁移视为任务域迁移，并在BioVid、SenseEmotion和PMED上验证，k-shot条件化可提升准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疼痛感知在个体间差异显著，人群级分类器难以泛化到数据集中所有受试者，因此需要个性化分类器来应对受试者变异性。

Method: 采用Few-Shot Learning（Meta-Learning子领域）实现个性化，将人群级到个体级评估的转变重新解释为任务域迁移（类别固定但目标受试者变化），并使用k-shot样本进行支持条件化（support-conditioned）适应。

Result: 在BioVid和SenseEmotion上（Leave-One-Subject-Out CV），二分类和多分类准确率分别为85.75%/35.49%和82.37%/41.88%；在仅有二分类基准的PMED上达90.47%。采用k-shot条件化后分别提升至86.25%、40.06%、83.43%、44.08%和91.25%。额外消融实验验证了方法的鲁棒性与个性化效果。

Conclusion: 结果表明，支持条件化的少样本适应能够在个体间变异性下提升平均性能。

Abstract: Pain perception varies substantially across individuals, making it difficult for population-based classifiers to generalise across all subjects in a dataset. One way to account for subject variability is to train personalised classifiers. In this work, we evaluate Few-Shot Learning, a sub-area of Meta-Learning, as an approach to personalisation in automated pain assessment. We re-interpret the shift from population-level to subject-level evaluation as a task-domain shift, where the observed classes remain fixed but the target subject changes.
