A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

</details>


### [336] [Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10366)
*Hanru Bai,Yuanchao Xu,Fengyi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出观测校正的Koopman框架，用新计算的浅层特征校正深层特征预测，加速冻结扩散模型采样，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet子集上分别降低19.9%和11.9%的Inception特征MSE，相对DDIM-50获得约1.9倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征缓存加速扩散采样时，仅依据过去特征进行预测，无法直接融入当前去噪状态的变化。作者希望探究能否用廉价、即时计算的浅层特征作为观测来校正预测，从而在不重训模型的前提下提升采样保真度。

Method: 提出观测校正的Koopman框架。利用校准轨迹辨识有限维、时间依赖的Koopman近似，联合描述浅层与深层网络特征的增量。加速采样时用该算子预测昂贵的深层特征演化，并用观测到的浅层特征新息校正预测状态；周期性全量评估刷新观测器，生成模型参数保持不变。

Result: 在三个数据集各三次10000张图像运行中，相比通道仿射预测，CIFAR-10的配对Inception特征MSE降低19.9%，十分类ImageNet子集降低11.9%；匹配消融显示观测校正额外贡献4.54%和4.67%的下降。观测器相对DDIM-50实现1.89倍和1.85倍的实测加速。

Conclusion: 以新鲜计算的浅层特征作为观测来校正Koopman预测，可在不重训去噪器的条件下提升参考采样器保真度并实现显著加速，为扩散采样加速提供了可控对比时间预测与观测校正的框架。

Abstract: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.

</details>


### [337] [Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10367)
*Eisuke Hirota,Aarav Sane,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"时间可解释性"新维度，通过动作分块的时间抽象提升可微决策树在序贯决策任务中的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释性为安全自主性提供透明决策支持，可微决策树（DDT）兼具自动可微策略与离散树可视化优势。但现有DDT不适配序贯决策：树的单时间步行为与人类多时间步规划存在固有错配。

Method: 引入时间作为可解释性新维度（时间可解释性）；提出两种融合动作分块的策略梯度算法；开发基于信息论的树重构算法以在训练中修改树，保持参数高效。

Result: 在四个仿真环境中，从蒸馏的动作分块策略热启动动作分块DDT效果最佳：在四个域中的三个匹配神经网络策略性能，且参数减少高达80%。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 动作分块的时间抽象能有效获得时间可解释的树，兼顾性能与参数效率，为序贯决策的可解释性提供新方向。

Abstract: Interpretability offers a solution to safe autonomy by providing transparency into an agent's underlying decision-making model. Within sequential-decision making tasks, differentiable decision trees (DDTs) are one approach to such interpretability, maintaining automatic-differentiable policies while providing humans with a discrete tree-based visualization. Nonetheless, current implementations of DDTs are not well-suited for sequential-decision making domains, as there exists an inherent mismatch between a tree's single-timestep behavior and a human's multi-timestep planning. Our work thus introduces time as a new dimension of interpretability, coined as temporal interpretability, and demonstrates how temporal abstractions via action chunking improve it. We achieve this by first introducing two novel policy gradient algorithms that incorporate action chunking. Additionally, to maintain parameter-efficient trees, we develop an information-theoretic tree restructuring algorithm that modifies the tree during training. Across four simulation environments, we find that warm-starting action chunked DDTs from a distilled action chunked policy is the most effective way to obtain temporally interpretable trees: they match neural network policies in three of the four domains while using up to 80$\%$ fewer parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/ei5uke/temp-interp.

</details>


### [338] [Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10368)
*Yibei Guo,Rui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过层跳过与重复程序，区分"选择带来的增益"与"所选计算本身带来的特定收益"，发现大量"余量"可由与输入无关的扰动在共享选项顺序下复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应计算研究常用已知答案的oracle评估来估计增益，但"选择带来增益"不能解释"为何所选程序有效"；作者希望厘清选择增益与所选层计算特定收益之间的区别。

Method: 在两个模型（Qwen3-4B-Base、Llama-3.1-8B）、4,413道多选题上考察32个层跳过/重复程序；将真实程序相对固定动作的增益，与相同位点上"输入盲"扰动、以及另一提示下重新评估的选择进行比较；并做KL校准对比、固定字母偏移、选项轮换及生成答案测试。

Result: 共享选项顺序时，对照扰动带来10.2–11.8与15.6–19.4个百分点的余量，超过真实程序的9.0与10.1；排序随菜单而变，Llama重复菜单上真实程序领先；轮换选项后两族余量骤降，但真实减对照仍为正差1.4–2.3与3.7–4.5点；KL对比点估计偏向真实程序但校正检验不确定；生成答案测试中搜索所选程序保留26.0点优势但无安慰剂对照。

Conclusion: 大量余量可在共享选项顺序下跨提示持续存在，却不足以证明所选层计算有特定收益；与这些对照的排序均无法识别该收益。

Abstract: Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests. Fixed letter offsets produce headroom of similar scale. Rotating options sharply reduces both families' headroom, while leaving positive real-minus-control differences of 1.4-2.3 and 3.7-4.5 points; their magnitudes and statistical support depend on further adjustments and the reference. A supplementary generated-answer test finds that search-selected programs keep a 26.0-point advantage over programs selected for other problems after rewording, without a placebo comparison. These results show that substantial headroom can persist across prompts with shared option order without establishing a benefit specific to the selected layer computation; neither ordering against these controls identifies that benefit.

</details>


### [339] [Continual Learning without Continual Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10379)
*Nikita Narayanan,Ritham Majumdarr,Sonali Parbhoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"持续推理"替代"持续训练"：基于PFN的模型经元训练后冻结，仅通过在上下文证据集中添加样本即可适应新类别与领域，从而实现无需参数更新的持续学习，减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要依赖持续优化，通过正则化、回放或参数扩展来防止新更新覆盖旧知识，但这些方式仍会带来遗忘或额外开销。作者希望从根本上改变范式，避免对参数进行持续更新。

Method: 提出Latent Concept PFN模型：这是一个元训练后被冻结的PFN模型，在潜在概念空间上进行上下文贝叶斯推理，该空间捕捉跨领域和类别的共享语义结构。新领域或类别到来时，将样本加入记忆，适应过程体现为潜在概念后验信念的更新而非梯度更新；概念标注仅在元训练中使用，作为潜在空间的软锚点而非固定瓶颈；模型结合概念标签与原始输入证据，可处理噪声、模糊或不完整的标注；无需任务标识即可同时处理域增量与类增量学习。

Result: 在类增量和域增量学习数据集上取得了有竞争力的持续学习性能，同时学习到可解释的潜在概念。

Conclusion: 将持续学习从持续训练转变为持续推理，通过冻结的PFN模型在上下文证据集上进行贝叶斯推理，可在不改变参数的情况下适应新类与新域，有效减少遗忘，并统一处理两类增量学习场景，同时获得可解释的潜在概念。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

</details>


### [340] [ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10381)
*Heejun Kim,Junyoung Lee,SangLyul Cho,Dongsu Han,Insu Han,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ResidualQuant，利用循环 Transformer 跨循环 KV 状态高度相似的特性进行残差量化，实现低至 INT2 的高精度 KV 缓存压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复应用共享块提升参数效率，但 KV 缓存内存随循环次数线性增长，成为限制批大小与推理吞吐的关键瓶颈；现有 KV 量化方法在低精度下精度损失严重。

Method: 观察到跨循环 KV 状态高度相似，以最终循环 KV 状态为参考，用低精度残差表示其余循环；并结合最小二乘缩放、残差旋转以及逐循环混合精度，实现高精度 INT2 量化与高效重建。

Result: 在多个循环 Transformer 模型及数学推理、代码生成任务上，ResidualQuant 持续优于基于旋转的 SOTA KV 量化方法；混合精度下精度接近 BF16，理论 KV 存储降低 80.7%，相同内存预算下精度最高提升 13.0%；RTX 5090 上固定批解码吞吐最高提升 2.73x，峰值吞吐最高提升 4.15x。

Conclusion: ResidualQuant 通过利用循环结构的 KV 相似性，在极低精度下显著改善精度-内存权衡，并带来实际推理吞吐提升。

Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks over multiple recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with the number of loops, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotations applied to the residuals, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, the reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 2.73x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 2x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 4.15x.

</details>


### [341] [Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10411)
*Yunxiao Zhao,Changxiao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将推测解码的训练与评估建模为马尔可夫奖励过程，提出EDR目标，能精确等于期望解码轮数，并给出无偏随机优化的时序差分梯度与离线评估器，在九个基准上超越现有目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行与半自回归推测解码器能一次前向提出整个块以提升草拟效率，但其训练存在难点：某一位置的草拟分布取决于解码轮从哪里开始，而轮次起点又取决于前几轮接受了多少token。现有训练目标多依赖块局部替代量，忽略这种跨轮耦合，因而无法直接优化全局解码效率。

Method: 作者将推测解码形式化为马尔可夫奖励过程，提出期望解码轮数（EDR）目标，用状态占用度对局部拒绝代价加权，精确等于期望解码轮数且不引入额外超参数；随后推导出精确的时序差分梯度，支持基于目标模型rollout的无偏随机优化；同一框架还给出精确的离线轮数评估器，可在共享目标rollout上配对比较草拟器而无需实际运行推测解码。

Result: 用EDR微调两种最先进草拟器DSpark与DFly，在覆盖数学推理、代码生成与对话的九个基准上，一致提升平均接受长度，并优于现有训练目标。

Conclusion: 该工作为并行/半自回归推测解码器提供了统一的理论训练与评估框架，EDR无需辅助超参数即可直接优化全局解码效率，实验证明其有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.

</details>


### [342] [Boosting and the Expressive Power of Simple Weak Learners via the $γ$-VC Dimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10383)
*Arthur da Cunha,Kasper Green Larsen,Liang-Yu Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过Alon等人提出的γ-VC维，研究弱学习到强学习（boosting）的样本复杂度刻画，并改进VC维与γ-VC维的关系及决策树桩、轴平行矩形的γ-VC维上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Boosting能将仅比随机猜测略好的弱假设转化为高精度预测器，但所得分类器的表达能力强烈依赖基类的结构。这一现象此前缺乏精确的复杂度刻画，需要合适的参数来量化基类结构与提升能力的关系。

Method: 采用Alon等人（STOC 2021）引入的γ-VC维作为分析工具，研究该参数与弱到强学习样本复杂度的关系；并重新审视经典VC维与γ-VC维之间的一般关系；同时对决策树桩和ℝ^d中轴平行矩形这两类基本概念类，给出γ-VC维的改进上下界。

Result: 第一，证明γ-VC维可刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度，误差仅差γ的一个常数因子缩放。第二，细化了经典VC维与γ-VC维之间的一般关系。第三，对决策树桩和ℝ^d中轴平行矩形，给出了γ-VC维的改进上界与下界。

Conclusion: γ-VC维是刻画boosting能力的一个关键参数，能精确（至常数因子）描述弱到强学习的样本复杂度，并加深了对基类结构与经典VC维之间关系的理解。

Abstract: Boosting converts weak hypotheses with a small edge over random guessing into highly accurate predictors, but the expressive power of the resulting classifier can depend strongly on the structure of the base class. We study this phenomenon through the $γ$-VC dimension introduced by Alon et al. (STOC 2021). Our first result shows that this parameter characterizes the sample complexity for weak-to-strong learning up to a constant factor scaling in $γ$. We then sharpen the general relationship between the classic VC dimension and the $γ$-VC dimension. Finally, we also give improved upper and lower bounds on the $γ$-VC dimension for the fundamental concept classes of decision stumps and axis-parallel rectangles in $\mathbb{R}^d$.

</details>


### [343] [Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10437)
*Yonghoon Dong,Minsung Yoon,Jaehyuk Kim,Jungwoo Park,Changyeon Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SQAM方法，用闭合形式的标量伴随匹配替代逐步向量-雅可比积，实现预训练流策略的高效离线强化学习微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流策略能表达丰富的动作分布，用离线强化学习微调可超越示范数据，但面对学习到的价值函数微调很困难，因为动作生成跨多个流步。伴随匹配虽能从最终动作回传价值信息，但需要在每一步做向量-雅可比积，计算开销随流步数和策略规模增长。作者观察到预训练流策略的批平均速度雅可比集中在对角线上，从而寻求消除逐步VJP的途径。

Method: 基于雅可比对角集中的发现，推导出一个闭合形式的标量伴随：用流时间对最终动作的价值梯度进行缩放，从而消除每步的向量-雅可比积。同时发现标量伴随下控制策略生成动作处的评论家价值尤为关键，因此结合标量伴随与这些动作上的价值惩罚，提出Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM)。

Result: 在OGBench上，SQAM的收益集中在四个最难的领域，每个领域的成功率比最强基线高出18至35个百分点。为验证其可扩展性，在真实双臂机器人上微调视觉-语言-动作策略，SQAM在全部三个任务上均优于监督微调。

Conclusion: 标量伴随匹配是一种高效且有效的流策略离线强化学习微调方法，既在困难基准上大幅领先，也能扩展到真实机器人的大规模预训练策略。

Abstract: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.

</details>


### [344] [OrBIT: Structure-Guided Embedding Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10385)
*Yunied Puig,Amit Kumar Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OrBIT 嵌入压缩框架，从轨道动力学学习可复用局部几何来约束共享码字，在多个 LLM 嵌入表上实现约 23–38 倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入表压缩方法通常预设固定编码几何（坐标块、低秩子空间或无约束码本）并在其中优化，作者转而探究编码几何本身能否被自动发现。

Method: OrBIT 从轨道动力学中学习可复用的局部几何，用以约束一小组共享码字；全局重建残差决定固定编码预算的分配；冗余重叠的局部图（charts）经粘合后使局部误差相互补偿；理论分析了紧致图几何对失真的控制、全局残差对顺序分配的引导以及数据几何引导的细化。轨道机制最终被编译消除，仅保留紧凑解码器。

Result: 在四个 LLM 嵌入表上，相对 16 位存储，GPT-2 实现 37.9 倍压缩，每个 7B 表均超过 23 倍，并在率失真性能上与已建立的量化与低秩基线具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 学习到的结构可决定存储内容、容量分配位置以及局部信息如何全局组装，表明编码几何可被自动发现且带来显著压缩收益。

Abstract: Embedding tables are among the largest components of modern language models. Most compression methods fix a coding geometry such as coordinate blocks, low-rank subspaces, or unrestricted codebooks, and optimize within it. We instead ask whether the coding geometry can itself be discovered. We introduce \emph{OrBIT}, a structure-guided embedding compression framework that learns reusable local geometry from orbit dynamics and uses it to constrain a small set of shared codewords. The global reconstruction residual then decides where the fixed coding budget is spent, while redundant overlapping charts let local errors compensate one another after gluing. Our theory shows how tight-chart geometry controls distortion, how the global residual directs sequential allocation, and how data-geometry-guided refinement improves the codec. The resulting orbit machinery is compiled away, leaving a compact decoder in which the learned structure governs what is stored, where capacity is allocated, and how local information is assembled globally. Across four LLM embedding tables, OrBIT achieves $37.9\times$ compression on GPT-2 and over $23\times$ on each 7B table relative to 16-bit storage, while delivering competitive rate-distortion performance against established quantization and low-rank baselines.

</details>


### [345] [A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10447)
*Randy Ardywibowo,Arnav Dalal,Jiantao Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 JOLT：单一策略同时扮演特权教师与非特权学生，教师用"结果奖励+向学生对 KL 正则"训练，学生接受密集的 on-policy 蒸馏，从而在推理、代码、工具使用等任务上提升训练效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 依赖结果奖励，在长程困难任务中监督稀疏、成功轨迹稀有且昂贵。On-Policy Distillation（OPD）可从更强教师获得密集的 token 级监督；自蒸馏进一步免去独立教师模型，用特权信息条件化同一策略充当自己的教师。但仅靠特权条件化并不保证蒸馏更新有利于学生——特权信息可能让教师走"捷径"，产生与学生当前行为不匹配的监督，甚至高性能教师也会导致学生性能下降。

Method: 作者分析特权教师的选择如何影响学生更新，推导出教师局部蒸馏更新是学生奖励梯度正数倍的充要条件，说明教师不仅要任务表现好，还要提供契合学生当前能力的指导。据此设计教师训练的代理目标：结果奖励 + 向学生分布的 token 级 KL 正则。进而提出 JOLT，联合训练同一策略的两种角色：以 KL 正则目标训练的特权教师，和对学生做密集 on-policy 蒸馏的非特权学生。

Result: 在数学推理、代码、工具使用和终端使用等任务上，JOLT 提升了训练效率与性能，加入学生奖励后还能获得进一步提升。

Conclusion: 该工作给出教师蒸馏更新与学生奖励梯度对齐的充要条件，据此提出的 KL 正则化教师训练代理与 JOLT 框架，能在多种任务上有效缓解稀疏监督问题并提升训练表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.

</details>


### [346] [Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10394)
*Richard Cornelius Suwandi,Feng Yin,Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Kernaut，将核设计视为开放式模型发现：用编码智能体写核程序，以构造契约保证有效性，配合质量-多样性档案与新颖性筛选，发现的核能泛化到未见任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核函数编码了众多机器学习模型的归纳偏置，但自动化核设计存在两难：固定语法（基础核与算子）能保证有效性却限制搜索空间；无限制程序虽自由却无法保证有效性。作者压力测试显示，22–58% 通过随机输入数值检验的LLM生成核在不同尺度或维度下会失败。

Method: 提出 Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut)，把核设计当作开放式模型发现：编码智能体将核写成程序；用构造契约（construction contracts）确保每个被接受的核有效；质量-多样性档案保存性能高且行为各异的核；新颖性筛选引导智能体探索功能上新的候选。

Result: 发现的核编码了可复用的归纳偏置并可泛化到未见任务。在留出的黑箱优化族上，发现的核优于在同一批episode上元学习的深度核；由十条酶动力学速率方程发现的核在五个未见机制上误差低于调优的ARD与深度核基线。这些核是可解释的程序，人类研究者可改进：人工改进版本进一步将留出预测误差降低5.7%，优化遗憾降低7.8%。

Conclusion: Kernaut 通过将核设计转化为开放式程序发现，并借助构造契约、质量-多样性档案与新颖性筛选，实现了既有效又可泛化、可解释、可被人类改进的自动核发现。

Abstract: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.

</details>


### [347] [Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10460)
*Hejian Sang,Zhengze Zhou,Shayan Mohajer Hamidi,Xiaomin Li,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Δ-MOPD，将每位教师的 teacher-minus-base logit shift 重新锚定在学生冻结初始点进行迁移，并系统比较其与端点策略监督在多教师 on-policy 蒸馏中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多教师 on-policy 蒸馏通常迁移教师的端点策略，该策略混合了后训练带来的变化与教师基座继承的偏好，导致继承的基座牵引可能掩盖后训练信号，阻碍有效迁移。

Method: Δ-MOPD 迁移每位教师的 teacher-minus-base logit 差异，并将该差异重新锚定在学生冻结的初始化上；在 common-domain 组合与 routed-domain 蒸馏两种设置下，固定教师选择，与端点监督进行对比，并考察组合、分阶段路由和交错路由等情形。

Result: 揭示了继承基座牵引可超过后训练偏移的机制，去除后可降低教师项范数比与 target-student KL；三教师组合时 Δ-MOPD 比端点组合高 4.11 Math 与 1.95 五基准点，两教师时精度相当；分阶段路由下两种顺序平均性能更高，顺序差距从 10.50 降至 6.42 点；交错路由下两者表现相近。

Conclusion: 目标构造是多教师 on-policy 蒸馏中独立于教师选择的设计维度；shift 目标在教师信号于同一状态组合时尤为有用，分阶段结果提示该收益可能扩展到跨训练阶段累积的信号。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL.
  Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.

</details>


### [348] [Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10395)
*Amartya Roy,Sayar Karmakar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer能否精确执行因果发现算法，通过显式构造固定权重的Transformer来复现连续优化方法的单步更新，并验证其精确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer已被证明能在输入数据上执行算法，作者希望探究其能否同样用于因果发现，即精确执行因果发现中的连续优化方法。

Method: 研究一种在强制无环约束下反复更新候选因果图的标准连续方法，显式构造一个固定权重Transformer，使其前向传播精确复现该方法的一次更新，重复堆叠即可复现整个优化轨迹；Transformer在更新间携带当前图与算法的乘子，并给出更新次数可预先计算及舍入误差有界的条件。

Result: 构造的模块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致；在合成数据和七个已发表基准网络拓扑上的算术重演继承了参考求解器的成功与失败；而普通注意力模型在给定训练预算下无法可靠执行该更新或迁移到更大图。

Conclusion: 该工作将精确的算法执行与准确的因果恢复区分开来；梯度训练能否在构造所属的架构类中学会执行器仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.

</details>


### [349] [Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10536)
*Saif Punjwani,Micah Goldblum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ExpDis框架，将探索与优化解耦：用带新颖性奖励的探索策略生成轨迹，过滤后蒸馏到独立的学生策略，多轮交替进行。在七个数学推理基准和两个模型家族上，ExpDis在相同墙钟预算下优于DAPO，并展现更好的pass@k扩展，表明能产生更多样化的正确解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR有潜力发现新的推理策略，模型理论上可采样出训练数据中不存在的新想法。但实践中为RLVR加入强新颖性激励效果有限且会损害模型质量，且因为可验证奖励只监督模型知识与行为的很小一部分，这类退化很难恢复。因此需要一种既能大力探索又不损害模型质量的方法。

Method: 提出Exploration-Distillation（ExpDis）框架，将探索与优化解耦。具体做法：训练一个或多个带新颖性奖励的探索者策略；对其轨迹按正确性和质量进行过滤；将过滤后的轨迹蒸馏到一个独立的学生策略中；学生策略训练时不使用新颖性奖励。以上过程重复多轮，交替进行探索与优化。

Result: 在七个数学推理基准和两个模型家族上，ExpDis在相同墙钟预算下优于DAPO。此外观察到更好的pass@k扩展表现，说明ExpDis训练出的模型能生成更多样化的正确解。

Conclusion: 通过解耦探索与优化，ExpDis能够在不损害学生策略的前提下积极扩大探索规模，从而在保持模型质量的同时提升推理性能与解的多样性，验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.

</details>


### [350] [Cross-Domain Pretraining for Steady-State Neural CFD Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10398)
*Anthony Zhou,Amir Barati Farimani,Shirley Ho,Rudy Morel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 跨域预训练显著提升 CFD 神经代理模型的零样本/少样本泛化能力，微调后误差降低 2-3 倍，样本需求减少 8 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFD 神经代理模型可加速仿真、促进工程创新，但核心瓶颈是难以泛化到训练集之外的几何与应用场景。现有做法是为特定应用重造数据集，代价高昂（需反复运行数值求解器）。

Method: 研究跨不同几何、边界条件与精度等级的神经代理模型训练；采用跨域预训练 + 微调策略，并与从头训练、领域专家模型迁移进行对比；分析跨域预训练的作用机理。

Result: 跨域预训练优于从头训练与领域专家迁移；微调后在相同样本量下误差降低 2-3 倍，达到相同误差所需样本减少 8 倍；该收益与架构无关，且随模型规模和预训练数据多样性提升；简单合并稳态数据集即足够且有效。

Conclusion: 鉴于 CFD 数据生成成本高昂，通过跨域预训练复用现有数据集，将成为未来代理模型拓展新问题与新场景的重要策略。

Abstract: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have the potential to greatly enhance engineering innovation through accelerating simulation. However, the primary limitation for neural surrogates is the lack of generalization to geometries and applications beyond the training set, which is significant given the diversity of engineering scenarios. Currently, this is addressed by generating a new dataset for a specific application; however, this requires running costly numerical solvers. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this by studying neural surrogates trained across different geometries, boundary conditions, and fidelities. We find that cross-domain pretraining improves zero- and few-shot performance on held-out datasets relative to both training from scratch and transferring from domain-specific experts. In particular, finetuning a pretrained, cross-domain model can achieve 2-3x lower errors at the same sample size and use 8x fewer samples to achieve the same error, compared to training from scratch. This benefit is architecture agnostic and improves with model size and pretraining dataset diversity. Furthermore, we study how and why cross-domain pretraining works in CFD surrogates, and find that simply pooling steady-state datasets is both sufficient and effective. Given the high cost of generating CFD data, leveraging existing datasets through cross-domain pretraining will likely be a valuable strategy as future surrogates expand to tackle new problems and use cases.

</details>


### [351] [Which Rollout Taught It That? BehaviorTrace and the Limits of Training-Data Attribution in Online RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10422)
*Amit Nautiyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究在线RL微调(GRPO)中的rollout归因问题，提出BehaviorTrace评测框架，发现多数归因信号来自混淆因素，并提出评估清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当强化学习为语言模型教会新行为时，我们能否找到教会它的训练rollout？归因方法声称可以时，如何验证其答案是真实的？作者希望建立一个有已知因果的受控实验来严格检验归因方法的有效性。

Method: 提出BehaviorTrace开放评测框架，结合全梯度草图、planted-behavior(植入已知原因的行为)设置，以及对梯度幅度、流畅度、提升空间、种子和生成采样变异性的控制。在Qwen2.5-1.5B上用三个种子测试现有估计器（GAS即重归一化TracInCP、TRAK式估计器），不提出新方法。

Result: 多数表面归因信号来自混淆：仅按梯度大小排序训练步的对照达到4.2–4.5倍随机水平，并在三个种子中的两个上匹配或超过最佳定向估计器；饱和检查点上，模型流畅度预测行为标签的效果至少不逊于所有对比的梯度方法。控制流畅度后，逐rollout结果随种子和生成采样变化，单次运行无法定论。唯有触发token的梯度与行为实际发生处的目标对齐这一信号在三个种子上均成立。

Conclusion: 作者将发现转化为评估RL归因的清单，强调需控制混淆因素并进行多种子、多采样验证；仅触发token梯度对齐信号具有稳健性。

Abstract: When reinforcement learning teaches a language model a new behavior, can we find the training rollouts that taught it? And when an attribution method says it can, how do we know the answer is real? We study both questions on online RL fine-tuning with GRPO, using a planted behavior with a known cause. We release BehaviorTrace, an open evaluation harness that combines full-gradient sketching, the planted-behavior setup, and controls for gradient magnitude, fluency, headroom, and variation across seeds and generation draws. Across three seeds on Qwen2.5-1.5B, much of the apparent attribution signal comes from confounds. A control that ranks training steps by gradient size alone, with no behavior target, reaches 4.2 to 4.5 times chance and matches or beats the best targeted estimator on two of three seeds. At saturated checkpoints, model fluency predicts the behavior label at least as well as every gradient method we compared it with. Once fluency is controlled, the per-rollout results change from seed to seed and from one generation draw to the next, so a single run cannot settle the question. One signal does hold on all three seeds. The gradient of the trigger tokens aligns with a target built where the behavior actually occurs. We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating attribution in RL. We test existing estimators, including GAS (renormalized TracInCP) and a TRAK-style estimator, and do not propose a new one.

</details>


### [352] [Seq-Flow: Efficient Probabilistic Forecasting with Self-Rollout Error Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10440)
*Yinan Huang,Shitij Govil,Bo Dai,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Seq-Flow，用条件流模型把上一次预测分布直接输运到更新后的分布，实现少量采样步内的高质量预测更新，并配合self-rollout训练缓解误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学预测任务需要随新观测不断更新未来轨迹分布。传统扩散/流模型每次从高斯噪声采样，需大量采样步；热启动方法复用旧预测降低成本，但模型未针对"更新"本身训练，少步采样时质量变差。

Method: Seq-Flow是条件流模型，其ODE将样本从上一次预测分布输运到更新后的分布，因相邻预测差异较小，可从信息丰富的初始分布出发，仅需少量流评估。针对递归复用导致误差累积的问题，采用self-rollout训练：用模型的滑动平均副本生成预测，作为后续训练更新的初始状态（区别于self-forcing把生成输出作为条件上下文）。

Result: 在粒子加速器束流预测中，少NFE采样预算下CRPS降低65%；在流体动力学预测任务上与强基线相当。尽管训练时最多自回归4次更新，推理时在400次以上连续更新中仍保持准确。

Conclusion: Seq-Flow通过"从旧预测分布到新预测分布"的流式输运建模与self-rollout训练，实现了少步、低成本且长程稳定的科学预测更新，代码已开源。

Abstract: Many scientific forecasting tasks require updating a distribution over future trajectories as new observations arrive. Conventional diffusion and flow models generate each forecast from Gaussian noise, often at the cost of many sampling steps. Warm-start methods reuse earlier predictions to reduce this cost, but their models are not trained to perform the forecast update itself, which can compromise quality under few-step sampling. In this work, we introduce Seq-Flow, a conditional flow model whose ODE transports samples from the previous forecast distribution to the updated one. Because successive forecasts often differ only modestly, this transport starts from an informative distribution and can produce accurate updates with few flow evaluations. Recursive reuse also creates a challenge: errors in one forecast become errors in the initial states of subsequent flows. We address this with self-rollout training, in which a moving average copy of the model generates forecasts that initialize later training updates. Unlike self-forcing methods, which reuse generated outputs as conditioning context, Seq-Flow reuses them as the source of the next flow. Experiments On particle-accelerator beam spill forecasting show Seq-Flow reduces CRPS by 65% under a few-NFE sampling budget, while remaining competitive with strong baselines on fluid-dynamics forecasting tasks. Although trained on self-rollouts of at most four updates, Seq-Flow remains accurate over more than 400 consecutive updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/Seq-Flow.

</details>


### [353] [NeuralBES: A Differentiable, Control-Aware Emulator for Scalable Building Energy Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10459)
*Ting-Yu Dai,Takuya Kurihana,Wing Yee Au,Hon Yung Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuralBES是一种可微分建筑能耗仿真器，用共享神经编码器将建筑元数据映射为物理有界的RC模型参数，通过log空间并行扫描求解线性递推并保持物理有效性，在精度与可扩展性间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求侧灵活性（预测、转移、削减住宅负荷）依赖可信赖的热模型，但现有工具面临两难：高保真物理仿真器（如EnergyPlus）准确却串行且需逐栋校准；纯数据驱动序列模型可扩展却抛弃了物理结构，预测可信度低。

Method: 提出NeuralBES，一种可微分仿真器：以共享神经编码器参数化RC热模型，将静态建筑元数据（面积、年代、HVAC类型）映射为物理有界的电容、电导和设备系数；这些系数构成标量线性递推，用log空间并行扫描求解；通过预测-校正循环处理恒温器-温度非线性并保持全时域梯度流。在ResStock数据集跨三个气候区训练。

Result: 单一编码器可处理多种建筑原型、年代和气候区，而黑盒基线产生统计合理但物理不一致的轨迹。全年滚动预测中，NeuralBES是唯一同时满足物理有效且精度在最强原始误差基线4个MAPE点内的数据驱动模型，参数量比Transformer和循环基线少约一个数量级；在参数量持平的物理有效基线中，其MAPE不到灰盒RC方案的一半。

Conclusion: NeuralBES通过将神经编码器与物理有界的RC模型结合，实现了可扩展且物理可信的建筑能耗仿真，在精度、物理一致性与参数效率上均优于现有基线，为需求侧灵活性提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Demand-side flexibility i.e. forecasting, shifting, and curtailing residential energy loads, depends on thermal models trusted across millions of heterogeneous buildings. Existing tools force a hard tradeoff: high-fidelity physics simulators such as EnergyPlus are accurate but sequential and require per-building calibration, while purely data-driven sequence models scale but abandon the physical structure that makes their predictions trustworthy.
  We introduce NeuralBES (Building Energy Simulation), a differentiable emulator that resolves this tradeoff by parameterizing a resistance--capacitance (RC) based thermal model with a shared neural encoder: static building metadata such as floor area, vintage, and HVAC type is mapped to physically bounded capacitances, conductances, and equipment coefficients, which become the coefficients of a scalar linear recurrence solved via a log-space parallel scan, and a predictor--corrector loop closes the thermostat--temperature nonlinearity while preserving full-horizon gradient flow. Trained on the ResStock dataset across three climate zones, NeuralBES handles heterogeneous building archetypes, vintages, and climate zones within a single trained encoder, while black-box baselines produce statistically plausible but physically inconsistent trajectories. On the annual full-year rollout, NeuralBES is the only data-conditioned model that is simultaneously physics-valid and accurate to within 4 MAPE points of the strongest raw-error baseline, while operating at roughly an order of magnitude fewer parameters than the transformer and recurrent baselines; among physics-valid baselines at parameter parity it more than halves the MAPE of the grey-box RC alternative.

</details>


### [354] [Two-Level Softmax Sampling Done Right: Correcting Bias from Size Imbalance and Dispersion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10483)
*Walid Bendada,Guillaume Salha-Galvan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出两级softmax(2LS)采样存在由簇大小不平衡和簇内相似度离散度导致的系统性采样偏差，提出S-2LS与SD-2LS两种校正方法，以可证明更优的softmax近似和可忽略的计算开销修正这些偏差，并在五个大规模数据集上验证了改进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从softmax分布采样是机器学习的基础操作，但其线性复杂度在大规模场景下难以实用。两级softmax(2LS)采样通过将物品分簇、先采簇再采簇内物品，实现了亚线性时间采样，因而被广泛采用。然而，作者试图揭示2LS虽具效率优势、却引入了系统性且不良的采样偏差这一问题。

Method: 作者分析了2LS偏差的来源，即忽略了簇大小不平衡和簇内相似度离散度，导致对簇的错误加权。针对这两类偏差，提出两种采样方法：Size-Corrected 2LS（S-2LS）校正簇大小不平衡，Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS（SD-2LS）同时校正大小与离散度，二者在理论上可证明提供更好的softmax近似，且计算开销可忽略甚至不存在。

Result: 在五个大规模数据集上进行了深入实验，验证了所提方法在采样性质上的改进。

Conclusion: 建议未来工作中一致地使用S-2LS与SD-2LS来替代标准2LS。

Abstract: Sampling from a softmax distribution is a fundamental operation in machine learning, but its linear complexity in the number of items makes exact sampling impractical at scale. Two-level softmax (2LS) sampling is a popular alternative enabling sublinear-time sampling. Assuming items are partitioned into clusters, 2LS first samples a cluster and then an item within it. In this paper, we show that, despite its advantages, 2LS introduces systematic and undesirable sampling biases, which arise from misweighting clusters by ignoring both cluster size imbalance and intra-cluster similarity dispersion. We propose two sampling methods, Size-Corrected 2LS (S-2LS) and Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS (SD-2LS), which correct these biases and provide provably better softmax approximations with negligible to non-existent computational overhead. In-depth experiments on five large-scale datasets validate the improved sampling properties of our methods. We recommend their consistent use in place of standard 2LS in future work.

</details>


### [355] [Oracle-Efficient and Parameter-Free Agnostic Smoothed Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10499)
*Sasha Voitovych,Adam Block,Alexander Rakhlin,Abhishek Shetty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个在agnostic设定下、无需知道基测度μ的oracle高效在线学习算法，基于高斯Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader，实现无参数化且达到近最优遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有smoothed online learning的oracle高效算法要么需要基测度μ的采样访问，要么需要标签能被固定假设完美预测，这两个假设严重限制了算法的适用性。相比之下，经典统计学习中的ERM在agnostic设定下无需任何数据分布知识即可高效学习，因此作者希望消除这两个假设。

Method: 提出基于高斯Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader（Gaussian FTPL）的算法。该算法是参数无关的（parameter-free），不需要知道基测度μ、平滑参数σ或时间跨度T，每轮仅需一次ERM oracle调用。

Result: 算法在VC维为d的二元类别上达到遗憾界Õ(d√(T/σ))，该结果在√d因子内是最优的。同时为建立该遗憾界引入了若干具有独立价值的新技术。

Conclusion: 证明了在agnostic设定下、无需知道μ时，仍可实现oracle高效的sublinear regret在线学习，消除了现有方法对采样访问或完美预测假设的依赖。

Abstract: Online learning is an attractive framework in many domains because it permits well-defined learning even when data are dependent or chosen adversarially. This generality, however, comes at a steep price, introducing significant statistical and computational barriers. Recently, smoothed online learning has emerged as a promising framework that interpolates between the fully adversarial and fully stochastic settings by assuming that the conditional law of each covariate has density at most $1/σ$ with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$, and it is known to match the statistical and computational guarantees of classical learning while still allowing for much of the flexibility of online learning. However, existing oracle-efficient algorithms require either (i) sampling access to the base measure $μ$ or (ii) labels that are perfectly predicted by a fixed hypothesis. Both assumptions limit the applicability of these algorithms, in contrast to statistical learning, where empirical risk minimization (ERM) learns efficiently in the agnostic setting without any knowledge of the data distribution. We show that neither assumption is necessary, giving the first oracle-efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in the agnostic setting without knowledge of $μ$. Our algorithm, based on Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader, is parameter-free: it requires no knowledge of $μ$, the smoothing parameter $σ$, or the horizon $T$, and it achieves regret $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/σ})$ for binary classes of VC dimension $d$ with a single call to an ERM oracle per round, which is optimal up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor. En route to establishing the regret bound, we introduce several new techniques that may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [356] [Why Forget-Only Unlearning Needs Memorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10519)
*Luka Radić,Vikrant Singhal,Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究仅遗忘（forget-only）场景下的机器遗忘，即仅给定已训练模型与待遗忘样本、无保留数据时，遗忘算法能否总是匹配从头重训。研究表明可行性取决于学习方法，并给出了匹配重训精度的下界及成功遗忘所需记忆信息的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘希望删除遗忘样本后的输出接近从头重训。但现有方法多依赖保留数据或额外训练信息。作者关注更受限的仅遗忘设定，追问：仅凭模型与遗忘样本，遗忘是否总能实现？以及若可行，需要模型记忆多少训练信息？

Method: 1）构造不同数据集产生相同训练模型、但删除同一样本后需不同输出的例子，证明仅遗忘可行性依赖学习方法；2）据此推导遗忘输出匹配重训精度的下界，并对若干标准学习算法实例化；3）推导算法为应对任意删除请求所需记忆训练数据的信息量下界，并以简单阈值学习器为例分析。

Result: 仅遗忘遗忘的可行性因学习方法而异，并非总是可能；给出了匹配重训精度的下界，并在多种标准学习算法上实例化。对于简单阈值学习器，处理任意删除请求所需记忆的信息可能高达整个数据集，尽管普通训练只保留一个边界点。

Conclusion: 普通学习中丢弃的信息在后续删除时可能是必需的，因此面向仅遗忘的模型可能需比标准训练保留更多信息。仅遗忘遗忘并非普遍可行，其成功与所需记忆量受具体学习方法约束。

Abstract: Machine unlearning asks for a deletion algorithm whose output is close to retraining from scratch without the selected forget examples. In this work, we study forget-only unlearning, where the deletion algorithm receives only the trained model and the examples to forget, with no retained data or extra training information. We ask whether forget-only unlearning is always possible. We first show that this depends on the learning method: different datasets can produce the same trained model but require very different outputs after the same examples are removed. Using this observation, we derive lower bounds on how accurately unlearning can match retraining and instantiate them for several standard learning algorithms. We then ask what must be true when forget-only unlearning succeeds. To this end, we derive lower bounds on what an algorithm must memorize about the training data to handle arbitrary deletion requests. For simple threshold learners, the required information can be as large as the entire dataset, even though ordinary training keeps only one boundary point. Overall, our results show that information discarded during ordinary learning may be needed later for deletion, so models designed for forget-only unlearning may need to retain more information than standard training does.

</details>


### [357] [Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10520)
*Zhewei Chen,Hao Zhu,Jiaojiao Jiang,Ahad N. Zehmakan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出G^2MLP，一种基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率引导的GNN到MLP蒸馏框架，通过识别并纠正学生模型中谱欠拟合与谱过拟合两种失败模式，在保持推理阶段无图依赖的同时提升蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN-to-MLP蒸馏方法主要迁移节点级预测或使用基于置信度的重加权，但未明确指出学生模型应在何处保留教师模型的图诱导几何结构。这一缺失导致学生表示空间出现两种谱失败模式：稀疏图上谱欠拟合（遗漏边界区域的高能方向），稠密图上谱过拟合（保留教师已通过聚合坍缩的伪方向）。

Method: 作者提出能量加权的师生对齐目标，并据此设计G^2MLP框架。该框架利用Ollivier-Ricci曲率来识别两种谱误差集中的区域，从而在预测级对齐与表示级对齐之间动态分配监督信号。部署模型仍为标准MLP，推理时无需访问图结构。

Result: 在节点分类基准上，G^2MLP持续优于无图蒸馏基线，在稀疏与稠密两种情形下均缩小了师生秩差距，并且无需架构改动即可迁移至Graph Transformer教师模型与链路预测任务。

Conclusion: 显式建模并纠正学生表示空间的谱几何误差是提升GNN-to-MLP蒸馏效果的关键。曲率引导的对齐策略为无图推理场景提供了一种有效且通用的蒸馏方案。

Abstract: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improves over graph-free distillation baselines, reduces the teacher-student rank gap in both regimes, and transfers without architectural changes to Graph Transformer teachers and link prediction.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [358] [Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08966)
*Xingang Guo,Jing Gu,Brian Jang,Renxiong Wang,Utkarsh Tyagi,Daniel Quigley,Steven Li,David Yan,Daniel Yue Zhang,Darvin Yi,Forrest Huang,HiJae Kim,Tianyi Zhang,Jared Lichtarge,Jihua Huang,Le Xue,Manan Tomar,Qiuyi Richard Zhang,Ruofei Yu,Seth Neel,Yaning Hu,Marcella Valentine,Xinzhe Jiang,Daniel Evans,Chenguang Wang,Dustin Tran,Tong Zhao,Yinfei Yang,Yunzhong He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"人类第六感"（HSS）基准，用于测评多模态大模型在直觉性视觉推理上的能力，发现当前最强模型远逊于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能从一瞥中恢复隐含信息（如因果、轨迹、社会关系、抽象规律），这种快速零样本的视觉直觉对与人共处的多模态大模型至关重要；但现有视觉基准要么聚焦专家级分析，要么只测低层感知，忽略了这种直觉推理能力。

Method: 构建HSS基准：涵盖多样化的图像与视频输入，按结构化分类体系组织条目，并为每条配备人工撰写的提示词，用以探测人们在瞬间推断出的隐式时间、空间、社会与抽象结构；此外还探索了应用动态视觉操作的智能体方案。

Result: 前沿多模态大模型表现不及人类：人类参与者准确率达93.1%，而最强模型GPT-6-astra即使以最大推理强度也仅达53.6%；智能体方案能缩小差距但未能弥合。

Conclusion: HSS将直觉性视觉推理确立为一个可测量的维度，揭示了当前基准上规模扩展所未能覆盖的重要能力，呼吁对该方向给予关注。

Abstract: Humans perceive far more in a scene than what is explicitly depicted: a single glance captures past causes and future trajectories; a quick peek determines if a vehicle can fit between two parked cars; a few seconds of video reveals who holds authority in a room; and a fleeting clip highlights subtle abstract patterns like unwritten rules or hidden labels. This capacity reflects a form of humanity's sixth sense: an intuitive reasoning mechanism that recovers implicit information beyond raw sensory perception. Crucially, this rapid, zero-shot visual intuition underpins everyday navigation and social interaction, making it a vital capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) deployed alongside people. Existing visual benchmarks, however, target either deliberate expert-level analysis in academic and mathematical domains or low-level perception, leaving the intuitive reasoning that people perform largely untested. To bridge this gap, we introduce Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning. HSS spans diverse image and video inputs, organizes items under a structured taxonomy, and pairs each with human-written prompts probing the implicit temporal, spatial, social, and abstract structure that people infer at a glance. Frontier MLLMs fall short of human performance: participants reach 93.1% accuracy, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches only 53.6% even at maximum reasoning effort. Despite excelling in many complex tasks that require advanced perception and knowledge, current models still struggle significantly on these visual tasks that are intuitive for humans. We further explore agentic setup that apply dynamic visual manipulation to HSS, which narrows but does not close the gap. HSS establishes intuitive visual reasoning as a measurable axis and directs attention to a capability that scaling on current benchmarks has so far left behind.

</details>


### [359] [Adaptive Workflow Intelligence: A Cognitive Architecture for Context-Driven Enterprise Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08793)
*Sreedevi Pandiyath Viswambaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应工作流智能（AWI），一种面向企业智能体的四层感知-认知-行动-反思（PCAR）认知架构，通过反思机制实现策略持续优化，在漂移与延迟压力测试中表现优于静态自动化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业系统依赖自动化工作流，但许多AI驱动方案在非平稳条件、政策演化和延迟反馈下表现脆弱。强化学习和LLM智能体虽具备部分适应性，却缺乏持久反思机制，也难以与受政策约束的企业运营直接集成。

Method: 提出AWI认知架构，围绕感知-认知-行动-反思（PCAR）四层循环组织，将反思作为策略持续精炼机制，结合混合推理、反思记忆与反馈驱动适应，支持环境漂移和运营约束下的决策。在具有延迟结果和受控机制转换的模拟企业决策工作流中进行评估。

Result: 在漂移与延迟压力测试中，受护栏约束的自适应方法比静态自动化恢复更快，同时保持政策合规；AWI的反思组件适度降低了行为振荡和反馈方差。

Conclusion: 反思式策略适应存在稳定性与敏捷性的权衡，AWI展示了在企业约束下兼顾合规与适应的潜力，但反思带来的稳定性提升幅度有限。

Abstract: Enterprise systems increasingly rely on automated workflows, yet many AI-driven solutions remain brittle under non-stationary conditions, evolving policies, and delayed operational feedback. While reinforcement learning and large language model (LLM) agents offer partial adaptability, they do not by themselves provide persistent reflection mechanisms or straightforward integration with policy-constrained enterprise operations. This paper introduces Adaptive Workflow Intelligence (AWI), a cognitive architecture for context-driven enterprise agents organized around a four-layer Perception-Cognition-Action-Reflection (PCAR) loop. AWI treats reflection as a mechanism for continuous policy refinement and combines hybrid reasoning with reflective memory and feedback-driven adaptation to support decision making under environmental drift and operational constraints. We evaluate AWI in a simulated enterprise decision workflow characterized by delayed outcomes and a controlled regime shift. In a drift-and-delay stress test, guardrail-constrained adaptive approaches recover more rapidly than static automation while maintaining policy compliance. Within this setting, AWI's reflective components modestly reduce behavioral oscillation and feedback variance, illustrating the stability-agility trade-off introduced by reflective policy adaptation.

</details>


### [360] [Accelerating Floating-Point Satisfiability Solving via Gradient Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08808)
*Yuanzhuo Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GradSAT将SMT子句求解重构为多任务学习问题，利用动态梯度归一化（GradNorm）平衡各子句梯度，结合GPU加速PyTorch后端与位精确局部搜索的两阶段流水线，缓解梯度主导问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于优化的SMT求解器（尤其针对QF_FP理论）在软件验证、程序分析和编译器测试中很重要，但受困于"梯度主导"现象：少数困难子句劫持优化轨迹，导致求解器无法满足整体公式并陷入局部极小值。因此需要克服该瓶颈。

Method: 提出GradSAT框架，将每个SMT子句视为独立的MTL任务，运行时应用动态梯度归一化（GradNorm）主动平衡各子句梯度幅度，惩罚主导梯度、加速滞后子句以实现均匀收敛。实现上采用两阶段混合流水线：第一阶段用GPU加速的PyTorch后端（符号编译与算子融合）在连续松弛空间导航至高质盆地；第二阶段将候选赋值交给位精确局部搜索引擎快速求解精确严格赋值。

Result: 通过稳定连续搜索动态，GradSAT缓解了先前基于梯度求解器的脆弱性，提供了稳健且高度可并行化的复杂约束求解架构。（摘要未给出具体量化实验结果。）

Conclusion: GradSAT通过桥接优化式SMT求解与多任务学习，有效应对梯度主导问题，为复杂约束求解提供稳健、可并行化的新架构。

Abstract: Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers are foundational to software verification, program analysis, and compiler testing, particularly over the theory of Quantifier-Free Floating-Point (QF_FP). While recent optimization-based SMT solvers have successfully applied gradient descent to continuous relaxations of logical formulas, they are fundamentally bottlenecked by gradient domination, a phenomenon where a small subset of difficult clauses hijacks the optimization trajectory, preventing the solver from satisfying the broader formula and trapping it in local minima.
  To overcome this, we present GradSAT, a novel framework that bridges optimization-based SMT solving with Multi-Task Learning (MTL). GradSAT reformulates the constraint satisfaction process by treating each SMT clause as an independent MTL task. By applying dynamic gradient normalization (GradNorm), GradSAT actively balances the gradient magnitudes across all clauses at runtime, systematically penalizing dominant gradients and accelerating lagging clauses to ensure uniform convergence. GradSAT implements this through a highly optimized, two-stage hybrid pipeline. First, a GPU-accelerated PyTorch backend leveraging symbolic compilation and operator fusion navigates the continuous relaxation to a high-quality basin. Second, the candidate assignment is handed off to a bit-precise local search engine to rapidly resolve the exact, rigorous assignment. By stabilizing the continuous search dynamics, GradSAT mitigates the brittleness of prior gradient-based solvers and provides a robust, highly parallelizable architecture for complex constraint solving.

</details>


### [361] [Route-Verify-Vote: Procedure-Conditioned Self-Consistency for Mixed-Domain Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08814)
*Xinchen Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Route-Verify-Vote（RVV）框架，通过领域条件推理程序与自适应投票策略，在SCoRE 2026混合域常识推理任务上实现79.4%精确集合准确率，系统排名第二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在需要以不熟悉方式组合熟悉推理操作时，组合泛化能力仍存在不足。SCoRE 2026在三个训练中未出现的混合领域上测试该能力，并要求模型识别每道题的全部正确选项，这对现有方法构成挑战。

Method: 提出RVV框架，实现程序条件下的自一致性，无需参数更新。Route利用给定领域标签选择推理程序，引导模型表示并应用相关约束；Verify提示模型针对约束逐项评估选项；Vote聚合完整答案集，并对两个最高频答案集票数差距较小的问题分配额外采样。每题样本遵循同一领域特定程序。

Result: 官方测试集上，每题16个采样答案集投票达到74.6%精确集合准确率；自适应RVV达到77.3%；在选定领域路由上结合多个模型将准确率提升至79.4%。最终系统在参赛系统中排名第二。

Conclusion: 结果支持领域特定推理程序与答案集分歧作为混合域推理中分配推理时计算的有效工具。

Abstract: Compositional generalization remains challenging when language models must combine familiar reasoning operations in unfamiliar ways. The Scenario-Based Commonsense Reasoning Evaluation (SCoRE) 2026 tests this ability on three mixed domains absent from training and requires models to identify the complete set of correct options for each question.
  We introduce Route-Verify-Vote (RVV), a framework for procedure-conditioned self-consistency that uses language models without parameter updates. Route uses the provided domain label to select a reasoning procedure that guides the model in representing and applying the relevant constraints. Verify prompts the model to assess each option against those constraints. Vote aggregates complete answer sets and allocates additional samples to questions with a small vote-count margin between the two most frequent sets. Samples for each question follow the same domain-specific procedure.
  On the official test set, voting over 16 sampled answer sets per question achieves an exact-set accuracy of 74.6%. Adaptive RVV reaches 77.3%, and combining models on selected domain routes raises accuracy to 79.4%. The final system ranked second among participating systems. These results support domain-specific reasoning procedures and answer-set disagreement as useful tools for allocating inference-time computation in mixed-domain reasoning.

</details>


### [362] [An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08875)
*Yu Cheng,Dehai Zhao,Zhongxin Liu,Qing Huang,Zhenchang Xing,Xiaoxue Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过87个SkillsBench任务的实证研究，发现同一Skill在不同配置下效用差异显著（36.78%任务上有的配置获益、有的受损），检索相关性排序会遗漏更优候选，按"所需操作支持度"重排可使首选通过率提升4.35–5.80个百分点，并总结出17条编写实践与两种多Skill组织方式的效果差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多描述Skill内容并评估下游性能，但缺乏对"效用为何依赖于内容、执行配置与多Skill组织方式"的解释。作者希望厘清相关Skill并非必然提升任务表现的原因。

Method: 在87个SkillsBench任务上开展实证研究，将下游效用定义为同一模型—工具链配置下相对No-Skill的通过率差值；对同一批Skill比较九种配置，再考察替代性已发布Skill及固定Skill集的三种组织方式；从37,596个Skill的精选语料中检索市场候选；采用LLM辅助分析内容、执行轨迹与最终产物，并经作者复核，将所提供的支持与实际使用及任务结果关联。

Result: 同一Skill在36.78%的任务上对部分配置有益、对另一些配置有害，轨迹显示推荐流程可能变成执行负担；相关性排序会忽略更有用的候选；在评估的候选集内，按所需操作支持度重排使三种配置的首选通过率提升4.35–5.80个百分点；归纳出17条编写实践，关联可执行流程与恢复、任务要求保持及最终产物检查；Stage Plan与Dependency DAG优于仅用使用顺序，DAG的额外收益集中于提供五或六个Skill的任务。

Conclusion: 研究提示开发者应评估"可用操作支持"而非仅凭相关性；允许在保持任务要求的前提下调整流程；在组织多Skill时显式表达产物依赖关系。

Abstract: Agent Skills package procedural guidance and resources for reuse, but a relevant Skill does not necessarily improve task performance. Existing studies characterize Skill content and evaluate downstream performance, yet provide limited explanations of how utility depends on content, execution configuration, and multi-Skill organization. We conduct an empirical study on 87 SkillsBench tasks, defining downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from No-Skill on the same tasks under the same model--harness configuration. We compare the same Skills across nine configurations, then examine alternative published Skills and organizations of fixed Skill sets under three selected configurations. We retrieve marketplace candidates from a curated corpus of 37,596 Skills. LLM-assisted analysis of content, execution traces, and final artifacts, followed by author review, relates provided support to actual use and task outcomes. The same Skills help some configurations and hurt others on 36.78\% of tasks, with trajectories showing that recommended procedures can become an execution burden. Relevance rankings overlook more useful candidates. Within the evaluated candidate sets, reranking by support for required operations raises first-choice pass rates by 4.35--5.80 percentage points across the three configurations. We derive 17 authoring practices linking executable procedures to recovery, preservation of task requirements, and checks on final artifacts. Stage Plan and Dependency DAG outperform use order alone, with DAG's additional benefits concentrated in tasks supplied with five or six Skills. These findings guide developers to assess usable operation support, allow procedure adaptation while preserving task requirements, and make artifact dependencies explicit when organizing Skills.

</details>


### [363] [How Could AI Eliminate Humanity? A Failure-Mode Analysis of Civilizational Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08878)
*Mikołaj Sienicki,Krzysztof Sienicki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出一个"失效模式"框架，用以分析先进人工智能可能如何导致人类灭绝、不可逆的文明崩溃或人类的永久性失能，其核心论点是灾难性AI风险并不需要意识、敌意或明确伤害意图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望突破"AI必须具备意识或敌意才会造成灾难"的常见预设，转而从系统性失效的角度理解极端风险，从而为防御性研究提供更清晰的分析基础。

Method: 采用非操作性的概念分析框架，识别多条相互作用的因果路径（如自主性失准、人类恶意使用、组织失效、竞争性部署），并考察能力、自主性、外部访问、持续性、制度保障与恢复能力保持等因素对风险严重程度的影响。

Result: 框架提炼出若干因果条件与可经验研究的中间量，并给出防御性研究问题，而非任何可能造成危害的具体操作流程。

Conclusion: 灾难性AI风险可源于多种相互交织的系统失效路径，且不以AI具备意识或恶意为前提；因此研究重点应放在可测量的中间变量与制度性防御机制上。

Abstract: This article develops a failure-mode framework for analyzing how advanced artificial intelligence could contribute to human extinction, irreversible civilizational collapse, or permanent human disempowerment. The central thesis is that catastrophic AI risk does not require consciousness, hostility, or an explicit intention to harm humanity. Instead, risk may arise through several distinct but interacting pathways, including autonomous misalignment, harmful human use, organizational failure, and competitive deployment. The severity of these pathways depends on factors such as capability, autonomy, external access, persistence, institutional safeguards, and the preservation of recovery capacity. The analysis is deliberately non-operational: it identifies causal conditions, empirically tractable intermediate quantities, and defensive research questions rather than procedures for causing harm.

</details>


### [364] [Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08900)
*Sihao Liu,Ligeng Zhu,Zijian Zhang,Dongyun Zou,Zhengyang Zhang,Changye Li,Song Bian,Song Han,Tony Nowatzki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Humanize —— 一套面向智能体编码的多智能体编排工作流，核心是"判断工程"：在规划、实现、评审与学习之间设置显式的机械强制决策边界，由人类批准计划契约、构建智能体分轮实现、另一厂商的评审智能体判定完成，确定性钩子而非模型在角色间路由工作并执行 72 道机械门禁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体编码让代码生成变得廉价，但可靠完成仍很困难：写代码的智能体本身就是判断"是否完成"的弱评审者，缺乏独立、可强制执行的完成判定机制。

Method: 以判断工程构建 Humanize 多智能体编排流程：人类批准计划契约；构建智能体分轮实现；来自另一厂商的评审智能体判定完成；由确定性钩子（非模型）在角色间路由任务并执行 72 道机械门禁。从马尔可夫链视角看，构建者与评审者交替采样形成双模型联合判定，缺陷只有被两者同时漏掉才能存活。研究基于其实际部署、118 份真实循环的公开复盘及其应用。

Result: 108 天发布 68 个版本，获 1,468 GitHub stars。应用包括：567 文件 gem5 构建系统迁移并通过上游评审；Kernel Design Agents 在 MLSys 2026 FlashInfer 竞赛全部三个 Full-Agent 赛道进入前三；HOA 在 IOI/IMO/IPhO 2026、IBO 2024 获满分，IChO 2026 得 418.5/437（金牌）；PutnamBench 672/672，Lean-Eval 榜首位列第一（251/303）。复盘显示独立评审能捕获构建者的无依据声明，但"停止"仍是关键弱点：按阶段分轮的报告中，三分之二的轮次发生在实现被接受之后。

Conclusion: 独立评审可有效拦截构建者的不实声明，机械强制边界与跨厂商评审是提升智能体编码可靠性的可行路径；但何时停止仍是主要短板。该证据为观察性研究，并非对工作流的受控对比。

Abstract: Agentic coding makes code generation cheap, but reliable completion remains difficult: the agent that writes the code is a weak judge of whether it is done.
  We present Humanize, a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built around judgement engineering: explicit, mechanically enforced decisions at the boundaries between planning, implementation, review, and learning. A human approves a plan contract, a builder agent implements it in rounds, and a reviewer agent from another vendor decides completion; deterministic hooks, not a model, route work between these roles and enforce 72 mechanical gates. Viewed as a Markov chain over repository states, alternating builder and reviewer samples jointly from two models, so a defect survives only if both miss it. We study Humanize through its deployment, 118 public postmortems of real loops, and its applications. Over 68 versions in 108 days, it gathered 1,468 GitHub stars.
  Applications include a 567-file gem5 build-system migration under upstream review; Kernel Design Agents, which extend the loop with a kernel knowledge base and profiling feedback and placed in the top three of all three Full-Agent tracks of the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer contest; and, through Humanize Olympiad Agents (HOA), full scores in IOI 2026, IMO 2026, IPhO 2026, and IBO 2024, 418.5/437 in IChO 2026 (gold-medal). Humanize also achieves 672/672 on PutnamBench and ranks first (251/303) on Lean-Eval's leaderboard even competiting with professional mathematicians. The postmortems show that independent review catches unsupported builder claims, but stopping remains a key weakness. In reports that separate rounds by phase, two thirds of rounds occurred after implementation was accepted. This evidence is observational, not a controlled comparison of workflows.

</details>


### [365] [Sequential Probabilistic Uncertainty Estimation for Parallel Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08901)
*Tunyu Zhang,Zihao Zhao,Yusong Zhao,Haizhou Shi,Zhuohang Li,Haoxian Chen,Hao Wang,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练的不确定性估计器 SAUCE，将多智能体系统的不确定性建模为对潜在系统级信念的序列推断，通过滤波式更新聚合轮次一致性信号，在五个骨干模型、五个基准和两种协议上提升误分类检测、选择性预测与校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）通过多智能体交互提升推理能力，但该类系统的不确定性估计研究不足。MAS 的可靠性不仅取决于单个生成结果，还取决于智能体在多轮交互中的演化过程，现有方法未能刻画这种系统级动态。

Method: 针对并行多智能体推理系统（多个智能体多轮求解同一问题并聚合答案），提出 SAUCE（Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution）。它是一个轻量、免训练的不确定性估计器，将 MAS 不确定性表述为对潜在系统级信念的序列推断，并通过滤波式（filtering-style）更新来聚合轮级别的共识（agreement）与生成不确定性信号。

Result: 在五个骨干模型、五个基准数据集和两种 MAS 协议上，SAUCE 在误分类检测、选择性预测和校准三方面均优于广泛的基线方法，包括基于标准对数似然的方法和针对 MAS 的不确定性估计器。

Conclusion: 将 MAS 不确定性建模为随轮次演化的序列推断是有效且无需训练的，能显著提升多智能体推理系统的可靠性评估能力。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have attracted growing attention for improving reasoning through interaction among multiple agents. In this work, we focus on parallel multi-agent reasoning systems, where several agents solve the same problem over multiple rounds and aggregate their outputs into a final answer. Despite their strong reasoning performance, uncertainty estimation for such systems remains underexplored: the reliability of a MAS depends not only on individual generations, but also on how agents interact and evolve across rounds. We propose SAUCE (Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution), a lightweight, training-free uncertainty estimator that formulates MAS uncertainty as sequential inference over a latent system-level belief. SAUCE aggregates round-level agreement and generation-uncertainty signals through a filtering-style update. Across five backbones, five benchmarks, and two MAS protocols, SAUCE improves misclassification detection, selective prediction, and calibration over a broad set of uncertainty estimation baselines, including standard log-likelihood-based methods and MAS-specific estimators.

</details>


### [366] [Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08902)
*Harman Singh,Anton Bakhtin,Rulin Shao,Gabriel Synnaeve,Ilia Kulikov,Rob Fergus,Sanjeev Arora,Kurt Keutzer,Jason Weston,Anuj Mahajan,Anirudh Goyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出在受控环境中评估AI智能体的"自我改进"能力，引入"智能体可塑性"（将经验转化为未来未见性能提升的效率）这一指标，揭示前沿模型在改进轨迹、迁移泛化与瓶颈上存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估大多衡量智能体在某一固定时间点的能力，而非其"如何有效地学习"。评估自我改进需要回答三个问题：未来性能是否提升并能泛化到学习之外；新能力获取的效率如何；自我改进过程在哪里失效。

Method: 在受控环境中研究自我改进：智能体将以往经验摊销为可复用的artifacts，并被未来实例继承。在每个checkpoint上，测量其在训练与留出环境的交互性能，同时计入学习成本。提出"智能体可塑性"——将经验转化为未来留出性能增益的效率。

Result: 在多个环境中，前沿模型即使在可比学习机会下，改进轨迹差异明显：部分模型获得显著且持续的提升，另一些则接近或低于初始性能；训练域内的增益往往只能部分迁移到分布外条件。终点能力与获取效率出现分化——最终表现最好的智能体未必是改进效率最高的。回溯改进循环中的失败发现不同候选瓶颈：低可塑性智能体常无法复用相关artifacts，而高可塑性智能体即便复用了相关artifacts仍可能失败，指向artifacts质量、泛化或应用上的局限。

Conclusion: 评估自我改进型智能体，不仅要衡量它们能做什么，还要衡量它们通过经验变得更好的效率。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly operate in environments where they can diagnose failures and improve through experience, yet existing evaluations largely measure what an agent can do at a fixed point in time rather than how effectively it learns. Evaluating self-improvement requires answering three questions: does future performance improve and generalize beyond the interactions that enabled learning; how efficiently are new capabilities acquired; and where does the self-improvement process break down? To answer these questions, we study self-improvement in a controlled setting where agents amortize past experience into reusable artifacts that are inherited by future instances. At each checkpoint, we measure performance on training and held-out environment interactions while accounting for learning cost. We introduce agent plasticity, the efficiency with which an agent converts experience into gains in future held-out performance. Across multiple environments, frontier models exhibit sharply different improvement trajectories despite comparable opportunities to learn. Some achieve substantial and persistent gains, while others remain near or below their initial performance, and gains within the training regime often transfer only partially to out-of-distribution conditions. Endpoint capability and acquisition efficiency also diverge: the agent that ultimately performs best need not be the one that improves most efficiently. Tracing failures through the improvement loop further reveals different candidate bottlenecks. Agents with low plasticity often fail to reuse relevant artifacts, whereas more plastic agents may still fail despite reusing relevant artifacts, pointing to limitations in artifact quality, generalization, or application. Evaluating self-improving agents requires measuring not only what they can do, but how effectively they become better through experience.

</details>


### [367] [AdaGuard: Enhancing Safety and Policy Compliance with Reasoning-Enabled LLM-As-A-Judge Guardrails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08923)
*Melissa Kazemi Rad,Sihui Dai,Isha Slavin,Kushal Chawla,Mann Patel,Jian Ni,William M. Campbell,Stephen Rawls,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出Adaguard，一个自适应LLM-as-a-Judge框架，通过动态策略执行和自适应推理预算分配，解决企业生成式AI安全机制的刚性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业生成式AI应用需要稳健的安全机制，以应对多样的风险姿态、不断演变的政策以及不同的延迟约束。现有guardrail方案往往过于僵化，依赖固定策略集，透明度和推理灵活性有限。

Method: 采用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（GRPO）构建AdaGuard，支持运行时泛化到用户自定义的安全与合规政策，无需频繁更新模型。核心创新在于动态推断输入-政策对的复杂度，使模型能在高速黑盒推理与可解释的、启用推理的审核模式之间切换。

Result: AdaGuard能够与体量数倍于自身的其他guardrail和前沿模型相媲美；其自动推理模式以极小的延迟代价恢复了始终启用推理时的准确率。

Conclusion: AdaGuard通过自适应策略执行与推理预算分配，在延迟约束与可操作性透明度之间取得平衡，为企业级生成式AI提供了灵活、高效且可扩展的安全审核方案。

Abstract: Enterprise generative AI applications require robust safety mechanisms that can accommodate diverse risk postures, evolving policies, and varying latency constraints. Current guardrail solutions often suffer from rigidity, relying on fixed policy sets and offering limited transparency or reasoning flexibility. We present Adaguard, an adaptive LLM-as-a-Judge framework designed to address these challenges through dynamic policy enforcement and adaptive reasoning-budget allocation. Built using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO), AdaGuard generalizes to user-defined safety and compliance policies at runtime without requiring frequent model updates. A core innovation of our approach is the ability to dynamically infer the complexity of input-policy pairs, allowing the model to switch between high-speed black-box inference and explainable, reasoning-enabled moderation. This flexibility enables developers to balance stringent latency requirements with the need for actionable transparency. This adaptive capability allows AdaGuard to rival other guardrail and frontier models several times its size, while its auto-reasoning mode recovers the accuracy of always-on reasoning at a fraction of the latency

</details>


### [368] [Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08927)
*Wenyu Du,Stephen Chung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出在开放世界多智能体科学环境 Station 中增强监督者机制与周期性元反思，用于开放式科学发现，平均重现 62.7% 的论文结论，显著优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统在指标明确的科学发现上进展迅速，但能否自主进行开放式科学发现尚不清楚，需要构建合适环境来评估这一能力。

Method: 将 Station 环境增强监督者机制与周期性元反思，鼓励缺乏中间指标时持续探索；从 ICLR 三篇口头报告论文构造开放式任务，只给研究问题、不给结果并禁用网络，将原文发现拆分为若干标准来评估智能体重现比例。

Result: Station 平均重现 62.7% 的标准，Codex Multiagent-v2 为 15.4%，AI Scientist-v2 为 14.4–20.6%；消融与行为分析显示两机制结合提升研究覆盖与连续性；在两个无参考论文的任务中，部分发现与知识截止后研究人员报告的结果高度吻合。

Conclusion: 合适的任务环境可使智能体在开放式科学发现中自主取得有意义的进展。

Abstract: Recent AI systems have made rapid progress in scientific discovery when given well-defined metrics, but whether they can autonomously undertake open-ended scientific discovery remains unclear. We investigate AI's ability to tackle open-ended tasks in Station, an open-world environment in which multiple agents simulate a scientific ecosystem. To tackle challenges specific to open-ended tasks, we propose augmenting Station with two mechanisms: a Supervisor mechanism and periodic Meta Reflection, which encourage persistent exploration even when intermediate metrics are lacking. We construct open-ended tasks from three recent oral papers presented at ICLR. We give agents the main research question studied in each paper while withholding the paper's results and disabling web access. We then measure how many of the original findings-partitioned into individual criteria-agents rediscover. We find that Station rediscovers 62.7% of the criteria on average, compared with 15.4% for Codex Multiagent-v2 and 14.4-20.6% for AI Scientist-v2. Ablation and behavioral analyses indicate that adding the two mechanisms together improves research coverage and continuity. We further evaluate Station on two open-ended tasks without oracle papers and find that some of the discoveries made by the agents closely match discoveries reported by researchers after the knowledge cutoff date. Together, these results indicate that a suitable environment can enable agents to autonomously make meaningful progress in open-ended scientific discovery.

</details>


### [369] [Socio-Foundation: A Model for Generalizable Individual Behavior Simulation via Hierarchical Capability Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08967)
*Liang Wang,Wenxuan Xie,Xinyi Mou,Yixin Luo,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FONTS分类体系，并基于此构建约1000万条实例的训练语料库与Socio-Foundation三阶段训练流程，同时建立IndiEval评测基准，使模型在个体行为模拟上比基座提升11.0分并接近前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟个体行为要求大模型在保持人格特质的同时适应动态社会情境。但通用大模型往往抹平人格差异，而任务专用微调又存在碎片化与泛化差的问题，因而需要新的组织框架与训练方法来兼顾专业化与整合性。

Method: 将个体模拟归纳为FONTS分类体系（人格保真F、结果实现O、行为自然性N、轨迹连贯性T、社会落地S）；据此整理约10M实例、覆盖14个数据集的标准化语料库；采用三阶段流水线：DAPO学习任务专家、离线策略蒸馏整合为能力专家、多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）统一；并构建涵盖29项指标的IndiEval评测。

Result: Socio-Foundation在实验中比Qwen3-8B基座高出11.0分，并接近GLM-5.2等前沿模型；消融实验与分布外评测进一步验证了有效性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: 以FONTS分类体系为组织框架、结合分阶段专家学习与蒸馏整合的训练方案，能有效解耦专业化与整合，提升大模型个体行为模拟能力及其泛化性。

Abstract: Simulating individual behavior requires large language models (LLMs) to preserve persona traits while adapting to dynamic social contexts. However, general-purpose LLMs often flatten distinct personas, while task-specific tuning suffers from fragmentation and generalization. To overcome these challenges, we organize individual simulation into the \textbf{FONTS Taxonomy}, comprising five complementary capability dimensions: \emph{persona fidelity} (\textbf{F}), \emph{outcome realization} (\textbf{O}), \emph{behavioral naturalness} (\textbf{N}), \emph{trajectory coherence} (\textbf{T}), and \emph{social grounding} (\textbf{S}). Grounded in this taxonomy, we curate a standardized training corpus library of approximately 10 million instances across 14 representative datasets and present \textbf{Socio-Foundation}. Socio-Foundation decouples specialization from integration via a three-stage pipeline: learning task experts via DAPO, consolidating them into capability experts via off-policy distillation, and unifying them via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). We also establish \textbf{IndiEval}, consolidating 29 metrics across the FONTS dimensions. Experiments show that Socio-Foundation outperforms its \textit{Qwen3-8B} base by 11.0 points and approaches frontier models such as \textit{GLM-5.2}, with ablations and out-of-distribution evaluations further demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization of our model.

</details>
